arabic: كان تاجر يملك مزرعة فيها ثور وحمار.
english_before: A merchant owned a farm with a bull and a donkey.
english_after: A merchant owned a farm with a bull and a donkey.

arabic: كان الثور يخرج كل صباح ليحرث الأرض تحت الشمس، ثم يعود متعبًا.
english_before: Every morning the bull went out to plow under the sun and returned exhausted.
english_after: Every morning the bull went out to plow under the sun and returned exhausted.

arabic: أما الحمار فكان يعيش في الإسطبل، ويأكل طعامًا جيدًا ويستريح معظم الوقت.
english_before: The donkey lived in the stable, ate good food, and rested most of the time.
english_after: The donkey lived in the stable, ate good food, and rested most of the time.

arabic: وفي مساء، نظر الثور إلى الحمار وقال:
english_before: One evening the bull looked at the donkey and said,
english_after: One evening the bull looked at the donkey and said,

arabic: «أنت محظوظ. تنام وتأكل،
english_before: “You are lucky. You sleep and eat
english_after: “You are lucky. You sleep and eat

arabic: أما أنا فأعمل طول النهار وأعود بجسم يؤلمني.»
english_before: while I work all day and come home aching.”
english_after: while I work all day and come home aching.”

arabic: شعر الحمار بالشفقة عليه، وفكر في طريقة تساعده على الراحة.
english_before: The donkey pitied him and thought of a way for him to rest.
english_after: The donkey pitied him and thought of a way for him to rest.

arabic: قال الحمار: «غدًا تظاهر بأنك مريض.
english_before: The donkey said, “Tomorrow pretend to be ill.
english_after: The donkey said, “Tomorrow pretend to be ill.

arabic: إذا وضعوا المحراث عليك، استلق على الأرض ولا تقم.
english_before: If they put the plow on you, lie down and refuse to rise.
english_after: If they put the plow on you, lie down and refuse to rise.

arabic: وعندما يقدمون لك الطعام، لا تأكل.
english_before: When they give you food, do not eat.
english_after: When they give you food, do not eat.

arabic: سيظنون أنك لا تستطيع العمل، ويتركونك ترتاح.»
english_before: They will think you cannot work and let you rest.”
english_after: They will think you cannot work and let you rest.”

arabic: فعل الثور ما نصحه به الحمار.
english_before: The bull followed the donkey’s advice.
english_after: The bull followed the donkey’s advice.

arabic: رآه العامل مستلقيًا، ولم يستطع أن يجعله يحرث الأرض.
english_before: The worker saw him lying down and could not make him plow.
english_after: The worker saw him lying down and could not make him plow.

arabic: أخبر صاحب المزرعة أن الثور مريض.
english_before: He told the farmer that the bull was ill.
english_after: He told the farm's owner that the bull was ill.

arabic: لكن التاجر كان يفهم كلام الحيوانات، وسمع خطتهما من قبل.
english_before: But the merchant understood animal speech and had already heard their plan.
english_after: But the merchant understood animal speech and had already heard their plan.

arabic: قال التاجر للعامل: «اترك الثور اليوم، وخذ الحمار مكانه.»
english_before: The merchant told the worker, “Leave the bull today and take the donkey instead.”
english_after: The merchant told the worker, “Leave the bull today and take the donkey instead.”

arabic: ربط العامل المحراث بالحمار، وجعله يعمل ساعات طويلة في الحقل.
english_before: The worker harnessed the donkey to the plow and made him work for hours.
english_after: The worker tied the plow to the donkey and made him work long hours in the field.

arabic: لم يكن الحمار معتادًا هذا التعب، وعاد مساءً منهكًا ومتألمًا.
english_before: Unused to such labor, the donkey returned exhausted and sore that evening.
english_after: Unused to such labor, the donkey returned exhausted and sore that evening.

arabic: استقبل الثور الحمار بفرح وقال: «شكرًا لنصيحتك! لقد قضيت يومًا هادئًا.»
english_before: The bull greeted the donkey happily and said, “Thank you for your advice! I had a peaceful day.”
english_after: The bull greeted the donkey happily and said, “Thank you for your advice! I had a peaceful day.”

arabic: لم يرد الحمار في البداية، لأنه كان غاضبًا من نفسه.
english_before: At first the donkey said nothing, angry with himself.
english_after: At first the donkey said nothing, angry with himself.

arabic: ثم فكر كيف يخرج من هذا الموقف.
english_before: Then he thought about how to escape this situation.
english_after: Then he thought about how to escape this situation.

arabic: قال الحمار أخيرًا: «سمعت صاحبنا يقول إن الثور إذا بقي مريضًا غدًا،
english_before: At last the donkey said, “I heard our owner say that if the bull remains ill tomorrow,
english_after: At last the donkey said, “I heard our owner say that if the bull remains ill tomorrow,

arabic: فسيرسله إلى الجزار.»
english_before: he will send him to the butcher.”
english_after: he will send him to the butcher.”

arabic: ارتجف الثور خوفًا.
english_before: The bull trembled with fear.
english_after: The bull trembled with fear.

arabic: لم يعرف أن الحمار يقول هذا الكلام ليعيده إلى العمل.
english_before: He did not know that the donkey was saying this to get him back to work.
english_after: He did not know that the donkey was saying this to get him back to work.

arabic: في الصباح التالي، نهض الثور بسرعة وأكل طعامه كله.
english_before: The next morning the bull stood up quickly and ate all his food.
english_after: The next morning the bull stood up quickly and ate all his food.

arabic: وعندما جاء العامل، خرج معه إلى الحقل وعاد إلى الحرث.
english_before: When the worker came, he went out to the field and began plowing again.
english_after: When the worker came, he went out to the field and began plowing again.

arabic: أما الحمار فبقي في الإسطبل يلتقط أنفاسه،
english_before: The donkey stayed in the stable recovering,
english_after: The donkey stayed in the stable recovering,

arabic: بعد أن جرب يومًا من عمل صاحبه.
english_before: having tasted a day of his companion’s work.
english_after: having tasted a day of his companion’s work.

arabic: عاش رجلان في حي واحد،
english_before: Two men lived in one neighborhood.
english_after: Two men lived in one neighborhood.

arabic: وكان أحدهما محبوبًا بين الناس بسبب أخلاقه الطيبة.
english_before: One was loved for his good character.
english_after: One of them was loved by the people for his good character.

arabic: أما جاره فكان يحسده على محبة الناس له،
english_before: His neighbor envied this affection
english_after: His neighbor envied him because people loved him,

arabic: ويتمنى أن يفقد كل ما يملك.
english_before: and wished he would lose everything he had.
english_after: and wished he would lose everything he had.

arabic: حاول الرجل الطيب أن يتجنب المشاكل،
english_before: The kind man tried to avoid trouble,
english_after: The kind man tried to avoid trouble,

arabic: لكن حسد جاره لم يتوقف.
english_before: but his neighbor’s envy did not stop.
english_after: but his neighbor’s envy did not stop.

arabic: وأخيرًا غادر المدينة، واستقر في مكان بعيد.
english_before: Eventually he left town and settled far away,
english_after: Eventually he left town and settled far away,

arabic: هناك فتح بيتًا للعبادة، وصار الناس يزورونه ويستمعون إلى نصائحه.
english_before: opening a house of worship where people came for advice.
english_after: There he opened a house of worship, and people began visiting him and listening to his advice.

arabic: سمع الحاسد أن جاره أصبح مشهورًا،
english_before: Hearing that his neighbor had become famous,
english_after: Hearing that his neighbor had become famous,

arabic: فذهب إليه متظاهرًا بالصداقة.
english_before: the envious man visited pretending friendship.
english_after: the envious man visited pretending friendship.

arabic: طلب منه أن يتحدث معه على انفراد قرب بئر قديمة.
english_before: He asked to speak privately near an old well.
english_after: He asked to speak privately near an old well.

arabic: وعندما اقترب الرجل من البئر، دفعه الحاسد إلى داخلها وهرب.
english_before: As the man approached it, the envier pushed him inside and fled.
english_after: As the man approached it, the envier pushed him inside and fled.

arabic: لم يمت الرجل في البئر.
english_before: The man did not die in the well.
english_after: The man did not die in the well.

arabic: وفي الليل سمع أصواتًا غريبة تتحدث تحت الأرض.
english_before: At night he heard strange voices beneath the ground.
english_after: At night he heard strange voices beneath the ground.

arabic: كانت أصواتًا لجن يعرفون أن ابنة السلطان مريضة بسبب روح شريرة،
english_before: They belonged to jinn who knew that the sultan’s daughter was ill because of a possessing spirit,
english_after: They were the voices of jinn who knew the sultan's daughter was ill because of an evil spirit,

arabic: ويعرفون أيضًا كيف يمكن علاجها.
english_before: and knew the cure.
english_after: and who also knew how she could be cured.

arabic: قال أحد الجن إن العلاج يحتاج إلى سبع شعرات بيضاء من ذيل قط أسود.
english_before: One jinn said the treatment required seven white hairs from the tail of a black cat.
english_after: One jinn said the treatment required seven white hairs from the tail of a black cat.

arabic: حفظ الرجل الكلام جيدًا.
english_before: The man remembered the words.
english_after: The man remembered the words.

arabic: وفي الصباح جاء أصحابه يبحثون عنه،
english_before: In the morning his followers searched for him,
english_after: In the morning his followers searched for him,

arabic: فسمعوا صوته وأخرجوه من البئر.
english_before: heard his voice, and pulled him out.
english_after: heard his voice, and pulled him out.

arabic: وبعد مدة وصل السلطان يسأل عن علاج لابنته.
english_before: Later the sultan arrived seeking help for his daughter.
english_after: Later the sultan arrived seeking help for his daughter.

arabic: أخذ الرجل الشعرات من القط وأحرقها
english_before: The man took the hairs from the cat and burned them
english_after: The man took the hairs from the cat and burned them

arabic: كما سمع في البئر.
english_before: as he had heard in the well.
english_after: as he had heard in the well.

arabic: خرجت الروح الشريرة من الأميرة، وشفيت أمام عيني أبيها.
english_before: The spirit left the princess, and she recovered before her father’s eyes.
english_after: The spirit left the princess, and she recovered before her father’s eyes.

arabic: فرح السلطان كثيرًا، وزوج الرجل من ابنته.
english_before: The delighted sultan married his daughter to the man.
english_after: The delighted sultan married his daughter to the man.

arabic: ثم مات الوزير، فأصبح الرجل وزيرًا مكانه.
english_before: When the vizier died, the man became vizier;
english_after: Then the vizier died, and the man became vizier in his place.

arabic: وبعد وفاة السلطان تولى الحكم،
english_before: after the sultan’s death,
english_after: After the sultan's death he took power,

arabic: وصار ملكًا على البلاد التي كان قد جاء إليها غريبًا.
english_before: he became king of the country where he had arrived as a stranger.
english_after: and became king of the country he had come to as a stranger.

arabic: وفي يوم رأى الملك جاره القديم بين الناس.
english_before: One day the king recognized his former neighbor among the people.
english_after: One day the king saw his old neighbor among the people.

arabic: عرف الحاسد أنه أمام الرجل الذي دفعه إلى البئر، فخاف العقاب.
english_before: The envier realized he faced the man he had pushed into the well and feared punishment.
english_after: The envier realized he faced the man he had pushed into the well and feared punishment.

arabic: لكن الملك أمر بإعطائه المال والهدايا،
english_before: But the king ordered gifts and money for him
english_after: But the king ordered gifts and money for him

arabic: وتركه يرحل سالمًا.
english_before: and let him leave safely.
english_after: and let him leave safely.

arabic: كان قط وغراب صديقين،
english_before: A cat and a crow were friends
english_after: A cat and a crow were friends

arabic: يلتقيان كل يوم تحت شجرة كبيرة عند طرف الغابة.
english_before: who met each day beneath a large tree at the forest’s edge.
english_after: who met each day beneath a large tree at the forest’s edge.

arabic: كان الغراب يطير بحثًا عن الطعام،
english_before: The crow flew off to find food
english_after: The crow flew off to find food

arabic: بينما يستريح القط في الظل، ثم يجلسان معًا ويتحدثان.
english_before: while the cat rested in the shade, and later they talked together.
english_after: while the cat rested in the shade, then they sat together and talked.

arabic: وفي يوم كانا تحت الشجرة،
english_before: One day, while they were beneath the tree,
english_after: One day, while they were beneath the tree,

arabic: فظهر نمر مفترس بين الأشجار.
english_before: a fierce leopard appeared among the trees.
english_after: a fierce leopard appeared among the trees.

arabic: رآهما واقترب ببطء، وهو ينظر إلى القط.
english_before: It approached slowly, watching the cat.
english_after: It saw them and approached slowly, watching the cat.

arabic: انتبه الغراب إلى الخطر، فطار سريعًا إلى غصن مرتفع.
english_before: The crow saw the danger and flew to a high branch.
english_after: The crow noticed the danger and quickly flew up to a high branch.

arabic: أما القط فلم يجد طريقًا آمنًا للهرب.
english_before: The cat could find no safe escape.
english_after: The cat could find no safe escape.

arabic: كان النمر أقرب إليه من جذع الشجرة،
english_before: The leopard was nearer the tree trunk,
english_after: The leopard was closer to him than the tree trunk was,
note: meaning wrong: leopard nearer the cat than the trunk

arabic: ولم يستطع أن يصعد قبل وصوله.
english_before: and the cat could not climb before it arrived.
english_after: and the cat could not climb before it arrived.

arabic: رفع رأسه ونادى صديقه الغراب طالبًا المساعدة.
english_before: It looked up and called to its friend the crow for help.
english_after: It looked up and called to its friend the crow for help.

arabic: فكر الغراب بسرعة.
english_before: The crow thought quickly.
english_after: The crow thought quickly.

arabic: رأى من بعيد رعاة يقودون أغنامًا،
english_before: In the distance it saw shepherds with sheep
english_after: In the distance it saw shepherds leading sheep,

arabic: ومعهم كلاب قوية تحرس القطيع.
english_before: and strong dogs guarding the flock.
english_after: and strong dogs guarding the flock.

arabic: طار نحوهم، ثم نزل قريبًا من الكلاب وأخذ يحرك جناحيه أمامها.
english_before: It flew toward them, swooped close to the dogs, and flapped its wings before them.
english_after: It flew toward them, swooped close to the dogs, and flapped its wings before them.

arabic: حاولت الكلاب الإمساك بالغراب،
english_before: The dogs tried to catch the crow,
english_after: The dogs tried to catch the crow,

arabic: لكنه كان يبتعد مسافة قصيرة ثم يعود.
english_before: but it flew a short distance away and returned.
english_after: but it flew a short distance away and returned.

arabic: وكلما اقتربت منه، طار أمامها مرة أخرى.
english_before: Each time they approached, it flew ahead again.
english_after: Each time they approached, it flew ahead again.

arabic: وبهذه الطريقة جعل الكلاب تترك مكانها وتتبع طريقه.
english_before: In this way it drew the dogs away and made them follow.
english_after: In this way it drew the dogs away and made them follow.

arabic: اتجه الغراب نحو الشجرة التي ينتظر عندها القط.
english_before: The crow headed toward the tree where the cat waited.
english_after: The crow headed toward the tree where the cat waited.

arabic: بقي يطير على ارتفاع منخفض حتى لا تفقده الكلاب من نظرها.
english_before: It kept flying low so the dogs would not lose sight of it.
english_after: It kept flying low so the dogs would not lose sight of it.

arabic: وكانت الكلاب تجري خلفه بسرعة،
english_before: They ran after it,
english_after: The dogs ran quickly after it,

arabic: دون أن تعرف ما يريد منها.
english_before: unaware of its plan.
english_after: unaware of its plan.

arabic: عندما وصلت الكلاب إلى الشجرة،
english_before: When the dogs reached the tree,
english_after: When the dogs reached the tree,

arabic: رأت النمر واقفًا قرب القط.
english_before: they saw the leopard beside the cat.
english_after: they saw the leopard standing near the cat.

arabic: نسيت الغراب في الحال، واندفعت نحو النمر وهي تنبح بقوة.
english_before: They instantly forgot the crow and rushed at the leopard, barking fiercely.
english_after: They instantly forgot the crow and rushed at the leopard, barking fiercely.

arabic: خاف النمر من الكلاب الكثيرة، فهرب بين الأشجار واختفى.
english_before: Frightened by the pack, the leopard fled into the trees and vanished.
english_after: Frightened by the pack, the leopard fled into the trees and vanished.

arabic: خرج القط من مكانه بعدما زال الخطر.
english_before: Once the danger had passed, the cat emerged
english_after: Once the danger had passed, the cat emerged

arabic: نظر إلى الغراب وشكره لأنه لم يتركه وحده.
english_before: and thanked the crow for not abandoning him.
english_after: He looked at the crow and thanked him for not leaving him alone.

arabic: عاد الصديقان إلى الشجرة،
english_before: The friends returned to the tree,
english_after: The friends returned to the tree,

arabic: بينما رجعت الكلاب إلى الرعاة، وبقي النمر بعيدًا عنهما.
english_before: while the dogs went back to the shepherds and the leopard stayed away.
english_after: while the dogs went back to the shepherds and the leopard stayed away.

arabic: كان ثعلب يعيش في كهف على جبل، ويعاني الجوع كثيرًا.
english_before: A hungry fox lived in a cave on a mountain.
english_after: A fox lived in a cave on a mountain and often suffered from hunger.

arabic: وكان فوق الجبل غراب له عش بين الصخور.
english_before: A crow nested high among the rocks.
english_after: A crow nested high among the rocks.

arabic: فكر الثعلب أن الغراب يستطيع الوصول إلى طعام لا يستطيع هو الوصول إليه.
english_before: The fox thought the bird could reach food he could not reach.
english_after: The fox thought the bird could reach food he could not reach.

arabic: ذهب الثعلب إلى الغراب وسلم عليه بلطف،
english_before: The fox greeted the crow warmly
english_after: The fox went to the crow and greeted him kindly,

arabic: ثم قال: «نحن جاران منذ زمن طويل.
english_before: and proposed friendship
english_after: then said, "We have been neighbors for a long time.

arabic: أتمنى أن نصبح صديقين وأن يساعد أحدنا الآخر».
english_before: and mutual help.
english_after: I hope we become friends and help each other."

arabic: لكنه كان يفكر في الطعام أكثر من الصداقة.
english_before: But food, not friendship, was foremost in his mind.
english_after: But food, not friendship, was foremost in his mind.

arabic: نظر الغراب إليه بحذر وقال:
english_before: The crow answered cautiously:
english_after: The crow looked at him warily and said,

arabic: «أنت حيوان يصطاد الطيور، وأنا طائر قد أصبح فريستك.
english_before: “You hunt birds, and I could become your prey.
english_after: “You hunt birds, and I could become your prey.

arabic: كيف أطمئن إليك؟
english_before: How can I trust you?
english_after: How can I trust you?

arabic: لا تكفي الكلمات الجميلة حتى أصدق نيتك».
english_before: Pleasant words cannot prove your intentions.”
english_after: Pleasant words cannot prove your intentions.”

arabic: لم يتراجع الثعلب.
english_before: The fox insisted
english_after: The fox did not back down.

arabic: قال إن الصداقة تنفع الجميع، ووعد بأن يكون جارًا مخلصًا.
english_before: that friendship benefits everyone.
english_after: He said friendship benefits everyone, and promised to be a loyal neighbor.

arabic: ثم حكى قصة برغوث ساعدته فأرة،
english_before: He told of a flea sheltered by a mouse
english_after: Then he told the story of a flea that a mouse had helped,

arabic: فرد لها الجميل وساعدها على أخذ نقود من بيت تاجر.
english_before: who later repaid the favor by helping her take a merchant’s coins.
english_after: who repaid the favor by helping her take money from a merchant's house.

arabic: استمع الغراب إلى القصة، لكنه لم يقتنع.
english_before: The crow listened but was unconvinced.
english_after: The crow listened but was unconvinced.

arabic: أجاب: «قد يساعد الصديق صديقه،
english_before: “Friends may help one another,” he said,
english_after: “Friends may help one another,” he said,

arabic: لكنك خدعت ذئبًا عاش معك من قبل.
english_before: “but you betrayed a wolf who lived with you.
english_after: “but you betrayed a wolf who lived with you.

arabic: إذا لم تحفظ صداقته، فكيف أحفظ أنا نفسي بالقرب منك؟»
english_before: How could I be safe near you?”
english_after: If you did not keep faith with him, how can I keep myself safe near you?"

arabic: ثم حكى الغراب عن صقر كان يظلم الطيور بقوته.
english_before: The crow told of a powerful falcon who oppressed other birds,
english_after: Then the crow told of a falcon who used his strength to oppress the birds.

arabic: وعندما كبر وضعف، صار يخدعها ليأكل من طعامها.
english_before: then when old and weak resorted to trickery to take their food.
english_after: When he grew old and weak, he began tricking them to eat their food.

arabic: قال الغراب: «أخشى أن تكون صداقتك مثل حيلة ذلك الصقر».
english_before: “Your offer reminds me of him,” he said.
english_after: The crow said, "I fear your friendship is like that falcon's trick."

arabic: ذكر الغراب أيضًا عصفورًا حاول تقليد نسر قوي، فوقع في مشكلة كبيرة.
english_before: The crow also recalled a sparrow ruined by trying to imitate an eagle.
english_after: The crow also told of a sparrow who tried to imitate a mighty eagle and got into great trouble.

arabic: ثم قال للثعلب: «من الأفضل أن تعرف حدود قوتك،
english_before: He warned the fox to respect his limits
english_after: Then he told the fox, "It is better to know the limits of your strength,

arabic: وأن تبتعد عن عشي. لن أترك حذري بسبب وعودك».
english_before: and stay away from the nest.
english_after: and to keep away from my nest. I will not drop my guard because of your promises."

arabic: فقد الثعلب الأمل في كسب الغراب، وابتعد وهو يظهر الحزن والغضب.
english_before: The fox lost hope and left, looking upset.
english_after: The fox gave up hope of winning the crow over and walked away, showing sadness and anger.

arabic: سأله الغراب عن سبب ذلك،
english_before: When the crow asked why,
english_after: When the crow asked why,

arabic: فأجابه بأنه وجده أشد مكرًا منه.
english_before: the fox replied that the crow was craftier than himself.
english_after: the fox replied that the crow was craftier than himself.

arabic: ثم عاد الثعلب وحده إلى كهفه.
english_before: He returned alone to his cave.
english_after: He returned alone to his cave.

arabic: كان في مدينة رجل يعيش من السرقة،
english_before: In a city lived a thief
english_after: In a city lived a thief

arabic: وله قرد علمه أن يؤدي حركات مضحكة أمام الناس.
english_before: with a trained monkey that performed amusing tricks.
english_after: with a trained monkey that performed amusing tricks.

arabic: اعتاد الرجل الذهاب إلى الأسواق،
english_before: He used it to distract marketgoers
english_after: The man used to go to the markets,

arabic: وكان يستعمل القرد ليشغل الناس بينما يبحث عن فرصة للسرقة.
english_before: while looking for a chance to steal.
english_after: and he used the monkey to distract people while he looked for a chance to steal.

arabic: وفي يوم رأى بائعًا يحمل ملابس قديمة مستعملة.
english_before: One day he saw a seller offering old, worn clothes.
english_after: One day he saw a seller carrying old, used clothes.

arabic: نادى البائع على بضاعته طويلًا، لكن أحدًا لم يرغب في شرائها.
english_before: No one wanted them,
english_after: The seller called out his wares for a long time, but no one wanted to buy them.

arabic: تعب أخيرًا، فجمع الملابس في صرة وجلس ليستريح.
english_before: and the weary seller wrapped the clothes in a bundle and sat to rest.
english_after: At last he grew tired, so he gathered the clothes into a bundle and sat down to rest.

arabic: اقترب اللص من البائع وجعل القرد يقفز ويلعب أمامه.
english_before: The thief made his monkey leap and play before the seller.
english_after: The thief came up to the seller and made the monkey jump and play in front of him.

arabic: ضحك البائع، وصار يتابع حركات الحيوان باهتمام.
english_before: While the seller watched, amused,
english_after: The seller laughed and watched the animal's tricks closely.

arabic: وفي تلك اللحظة مد اللص يده وأخذ صرة الملابس من دون أن ينتبه الرجل.
english_before: the thief quietly stole the bundle.
english_after: At that moment the thief reached out and took the bundle of clothes without the man noticing.

arabic: أخذ اللص القرد والصرة إلى مكان خال.
english_before: The thief carried the monkey and bundle to a secluded spot.
english_after: The thief carried the monkey and bundle to a secluded spot.

arabic: فتحها ورأى الملابس البالية،
english_before: He rewrapped the rags
english_after: He opened it and saw the worn out clothes,
note: wrong action, belonged to next chunk

arabic: ثم جمعها من جديد داخل قطعة قماش جميلة غالية الثمن،
english_before: in costly, beautiful fabric
english_after: then wrapped them again in a beautiful, expensive piece of cloth,

arabic: حتى يبدو ما بداخلها أثمن مما هو في الحقيقة.
english_before: to make the contents seem valuable.
english_after: so that what was inside would look more valuable than it really was.

arabic: ذهب إلى سوق آخر وعرض الصرة للبيع بسعر منخفض.
english_before: In another market he offered the bundle cheaply,
english_after: He went to another market and offered the bundle for sale at a low price.

arabic: وضع شرطًا غريبًا: لا يجوز للمشتري فتحها قبل دفع المال.
english_before: with one strange condition: the buyer must not open it before paying.
english_after: with one strange condition: the buyer must not open it before paying.

arabic: كان يريد أن يظن الناس أن بداخلها شيئًا ثمينًا جدًا.
english_before: He wanted people to imagine valuable contents.
english_after: He wanted people to think something very valuable was inside.

arabic: رأى رجل قطعة القماش الجميلة، فأعجبته وفكر أنه وجد صفقة رائعة.
english_before: A buyer admired the elegant wrapping, thought it a bargain,
english_after: A man saw the beautiful cloth, liked it, and thought he had found a great bargain.

arabic: اشترى الصرة من غير أن يفحص ما فيها،
english_before: and purchased it without inspecting it,
english_after: He bought the bundle without checking what was in it,

arabic: وأخذها إلى بيته وهو يتوقع أن يبيعها بربح كبير.
english_before: hoping to resell at a profit.
english_after: and took it home, expecting to sell it for a big profit.

arabic: سألته زوجته عما اشترى،
english_before: His wife asked about the purchase.
english_after: His wife asked him what he had bought,

arabic: فأخبرها عن الثمن القليل والربح الذي ينتظره.
english_before: Hearing of the low price and hoped-for profit,
english_after: and he told her about the low price and the profit he was expecting.

arabic: قالت: «كيف تشتري شيئًا لا تعرف ما بداخله؟
english_before: she asked why he bought an unopened parcel
english_after: She said, "How can you buy something without knowing what is inside?

arabic: ولماذا يبيعه صاحبه بهذا الرخص إذا كان ذا قيمة؟»
english_before: and why anything valuable would be sold so cheaply.
english_after: And why would its owner sell it so cheaply if it were worth anything?"

arabic: فهمت الزوجة أن وراء الصفقة خدعة،
english_before: She recognized the trick
english_after: The wife understood that there was a trick behind the deal,

arabic: وحذرته من شراء الأشياء المسروقة أو المجهولة.
english_before: and warned him against stolen or unknown goods.
english_after: and warned him against buying stolen or unknown goods.

arabic: أما اللص فقد أخذ المال ورحل مع قرده،
english_before: The thief left with the money and monkey,
english_after: As for the thief, he had taken the money and left with his monkey,

arabic: وبقي المشتري مع صرة من ملابس قديمة لا تستحق ما دفعه.
english_before: while the buyer remained with old clothes worth less than he had paid.
english_after: and the buyer was left with a bundle of old clothes not worth what he had paid.

arabic: كان عصفور صغير يزور طاووسًا كل صباح،
english_before: A little sparrow visited a peacock
english_after: A little sparrow visited a peacock every morning

arabic: ويبقى معه حتى المساء. عرفه جيدًا وأعجب به.
english_before: from morning until evening.
english_after: and stayed with him until evening. He knew him well and admired him.

arabic: وفي يوم اجتمعت الطيور فوق جبل
english_before: One day birds gathered on a mountain
english_after: One day birds gathered on a mountain

arabic: لتختار ملكًا يحل خلافاتها ويحفظ النظام بينها.
english_before: to choose a king who would settle their disagreements.
english_after: to choose a king who would settle their disputes and keep order among them.

arabic: اقترح العصفور أن يكون الطاووس ملكًا، فوافقت الطيور.
english_before: The sparrow proposed the peacock, and the birds agreed.
english_after: The sparrow proposed the peacock, and the birds agreed.

arabic: شكر الطاووس صديقه وجعله وزيرًا قريبًا منه.
english_before: The new king made his friend a close minister,
english_after: The peacock thanked his friend and made him a minister close to him.

arabic: صار العصفور يهتم بشؤون المملكة، ويأتي إلى الملك بالطعام والأخبار كل يوم.
english_before: who brought him food and news daily.
english_after: The sparrow looked after the kingdom's affairs and brought the king food and news every day.

arabic: تأخر العصفور عن موعده يومًا، فسأله الطاووس عن السبب.
english_before: One day the sparrow was late. Asked why,
english_after: One day the sparrow was late, and the peacock asked him why.

arabic: قال: «رأيت صيادًا ينصب شبكة قرب عشي، ويضع الحبوب داخلها.
english_before: he explained that a hunter had set a grain-baited net near his nest
english_after: He said, "I saw a hunter set a net near my nest and put grain inside it.

arabic: وبعد قليل دخل طائران كبيران إلى الشبكة فأمسك بهما».
english_before: and captured two large birds.
english_after: Soon two large birds went into the net, and he caught them."

arabic: أخبر العصفور الملك أنه يريد ترك ذلك المكان خوفًا من الصياد.
english_before: The sparrow wanted to move away,
english_after: The sparrow told the king he wanted to leave that place for fear of the hunter.

arabic: لكن الطاووس قال له: «لا تغادر بيتك؛ فالإنسان لا يستطيع الهرب من نصيبه مهما احتاط».
english_before: but the peacock advised him to stay, saying no one can escape fate.
english_after: But the peacock said, "Do not leave your home. No one can escape his fate, however careful he is."

arabic: أطاع العصفور الملك وبقي قرب عشه.
english_before: The sparrow obeyed.
english_after: The sparrow obeyed the king and stayed near his nest.

arabic: استمر العصفور في مراقبة المكان بحذر.
english_before: The sparrow remained watchful,
english_after: The sparrow kept watching the place carefully.

arabic: كان يتجنب الشبكة إذا رآها، ويبحث عن الطعام بعيدًا عنها.
english_before: avoiding the net and finding food elsewhere.
english_after: He avoided the net whenever he saw it and looked for food far from it.

arabic: ومع ذلك لم ينس ما حدث للطائرين اللذين أخذهما الصياد في ذلك اليوم.
english_before: He never forgot the birds taken by the hunter.
english_after: Still, he never forgot the two birds the hunter had taken that day.

arabic: وفي يوم آخر رأى عصفورين يتشاجران على الأرض.
english_before: Another day he saw two sparrows fighting on the ground.
english_after: Another day he saw two sparrows fighting on the ground.

arabic: قال في نفسه: «كيف أكون وزيرًا للطيور وأتركهما يتقاتلان؟
english_before: As minister, he felt he should intervene
english_after: He said to himself, "How can I be minister of the birds and let them fight?

arabic: يجب أن أنزل وأصلح بينهما قبل أن يؤذي أحدهما الآخر».
english_before: before they hurt each other.
english_after: I must go down and make peace between them before one hurts the other."

arabic: نزل العصفور بسرعة بين المتشاجرين،
english_before: He flew down between them,
english_after: The sparrow quickly flew down between the two fighters,

arabic: وفي تلك اللحظة ألقى الصياد شبكته على الثلاثة.
english_before: and at that moment the hunter cast his net over all three.
english_after: and at that moment the hunter cast his net over all three.

arabic: حاول الوزير أن يطير، لكنه وجد نفسه محاصرًا.
english_before: The minister was trapped,
english_after: The minister tried to fly, but found himself trapped.

arabic: جاء الصياد وأمسكه، ثم سلمه إلى أحد رفاقه.
english_before: caught and handed to the hunter’s companion.
english_after: The hunter came and seized him, then handed him to one of his companions.

arabic: تذكر العصفور كلام الطاووس، وفكر في الخطر الذي كان يخشاه منذ البداية.
english_before: The sparrow recalled the peacock’s advice and the danger he had feared.
english_after: The sparrow remembered the peacock's words and thought of the danger he had feared from the start.

arabic: لم ينفعه منصبه ولا حذره هذه المرة.
english_before: Neither his office nor his caution saved him
english_after: Neither his position nor his caution helped him this time.

arabic: ابتعد الصياد وهو يحمل الطائر الذي كان قبل قليل وزيرًا لملك الطيور.
english_before: as the hunter carried off the former minister.
english_after: The hunter went off carrying the bird who, a moment before, had been minister to the king of birds.

arabic: خرج الأمير معن بن زائدة في يوم حار للصيد مع رجاله.
english_before: The prince Ma‘an bin Zaidah went hunting on a hot day.
english_after: Prince Ma'an bin Zaidah went out hunting with his men on a hot day.

arabic: ابتعدوا في الصحراء، واشتد بهم العطش.
english_before: He and his men grew thirsty
english_after: They went far into the desert, and their thirst grew severe.

arabic: بحثوا عن الماء في أوعيتهم، لكنهم لم يجدوا ما يكفي حتى يشرب الأمير.
english_before: and found no water to drink.
english_after: They searched their containers for water but did not find enough even for the prince to drink.

arabic: وبينما هم يسيرون، ظهرت ثلاث فتيات يحملن قربًا من الماء على أكتافهن.
english_before: Three girls appeared carrying waterskins.
english_after: As they went on, three girls appeared carrying waterskins on their shoulders.

arabic: اقترب منهن معن وطلب قليلًا من الماء.
english_before: Ma‘an asked for a drink,
english_after: Ma'an approached them and asked for a little water.

arabic: لم يسألنه عن اسمه، بل قدمن إليه الماء فورًا.
english_before: and without asking his identity they gave him water.
english_after: They did not ask his name, but gave him water at once.

arabic: شرب معن حتى ذهب عطشه،
english_before: After drinking,
english_after: Ma'an drank until his thirst was gone,

arabic: ثم أراد أن يشكر الفتيات على معروفهن.
english_before: he wanted to repay their kindness.
english_after: then he wanted to thank the girls for their kindness.

arabic: التفت إلى رجاله وطلب مالًا ليعطيهن،
english_before: He asked his men for money,
english_after: He turned to his men and asked for money to give them,

arabic: لكن الرجال لم يحملوا معهم نقودًا في رحلة الصيد.
english_before: but they had brought none on the hunt.
english_after: but the men had brought no money with them on the hunting trip.

arabic: فكر الأمير قليلًا، ثم فتح جعبة سهامه.
english_before: The prince opened his quiver.
english_after: The prince thought for a moment, then opened his quiver.

arabic: كانت رؤوس السهام مصنوعة من الذهب.
english_before: His arrows had golden tips,
english_after: The arrowheads were made of gold.

arabic: أعطى كل فتاة عشرة سهام،
english_before: so he gave each girl ten,
english_after: He gave each girl ten arrows,

arabic: فحصلت الفتيات الثلاث على ثلاثين سهمًا ثمينًا بدل النقود.
english_before: thirty valuable arrows in all.
english_after: so the three girls received thirty precious arrows instead of money.

arabic: نظرت الفتيات إلى السهام بدهشة.
english_before: The girls were astonished.
english_after: The girls looked at the arrows in amazement.

arabic: قالت إحداهن لصاحبتَيها: «لا يفعل هذا إلا معن بن زائدة،
english_before: One said only Ma‘an,
english_after: One of them said to the other two, "Only Ma'an bin Zaidah would do this,

arabic: الذي يعرفه الناس بكرمه.
english_before: famed for generosity,
english_after: the man known for his generosity.

arabic: حتى سهامه التي يستعملها في الحرب تحمل الذهب!»
english_before: would give away gold even from arrows used in war.
english_after: Even the arrows he uses in war carry gold!"

arabic: اتفقت الفتيات على أن تشكره كل واحدة بكلمات من الشعر.
english_before: They decided to thank him in verse.
english_after: The girls agreed that each would thank him with lines of poetry.

arabic: أنشدت الأولى أبياتًا تصف رجلًا يجعل سهامه الذهبية عونًا للمحتاجين،
english_before: The first praised a warrior whose golden arrows could help
english_after: The first recited verses describing a man whose golden arrows help those in need,

arabic: حتى عندما يخرج لملاقاة أعدائه في القتال.
english_before: even those wounded in battle.
english_after: even when he goes out to meet his enemies in battle.

arabic: ثم أنشدت الثانية أبياتًا تقول إن الأمير يعطي بسخاء للأصدقاء والأعداء،
english_before: The second praised his generosity
english_after: Then the second recited verses saying the prince gives generously to friends and enemies alike,

arabic: ولا يتوقف كرمه في أوقات الحرب.
english_before: toward friends and enemies;
english_after: and his generosity does not stop in times of war.

arabic: أما الثالثة فوصفت كيف يمكن أن يدفع الذهب ثمن علاج المصاب
english_before: the third said the gold could pay for a wounded person’s treatment
english_after: The third described how the gold could pay for a wounded person's treatment

arabic: أو كفن الميت.
english_before: or a dead person’s shroud.
english_after: or a dead person’s shroud.

arabic: استمع معن إلى ثناء الفتيات بعدما سقينه وهو عطشان.
english_before: Ma‘an heard their praise after their kindness to him.
english_after: Ma'an listened to the girls' praise, after they had given him water when he was thirsty.

arabic: عرفن هويته من هديته،
english_before: They had recognized him by his gift,
english_after: They had recognized who he was from his gift,

arabic: لا من ثيابه أو مرافقيه.
english_before: not his clothing or attendants.
english_after: not his clothing or attendants.

arabic: وبقيت السهام الذهبية معهن، ذكرى اللقاء في الصحراء.
english_before: The golden arrows remained with them as a memory of the meeting.
english_after: The golden arrows stayed with them, a memory of the meeting in the desert.

arabic: خرج معن بن زائدة للصيد في الصحراء،
english_before: Ma‘an bin Zaidah went hunting
english_after: Ma'an bin Zaidah went out hunting in the desert,

arabic: وابتعد عن رجاله وهو يطارد غزالًا.
english_before: and became separated from his men.
english_after: and strayed from his men while chasing a gazelle.

arabic: وفي الطريق رأى أعرابيًا يركب حمارًا ويحمل خيارًا طازجًا.
english_before: He met a Bedouin on a donkey carrying fresh cucumbers
english_after: On the way he saw a Bedouin riding a donkey and carrying fresh cucumbers.

arabic: سلم عليه وسأله إلى أين يذهب.
english_before: and asked where he was going.
english_after: He greeted him and asked where he was going.

arabic: قال الأعرابي إن بلاده عانت الجفاف سنتين،
english_before: The Bedouin said his land had suffered two years of drought
english_after: The Bedouin said his land had suffered two years of drought

arabic: ثم جاء موسم جيد ونضج الخيار مبكرًا.
english_before: before an early cucumber harvest.
english_after: then a good season came and the cucumbers ripened early.

arabic: أراد أن يهديه إلى الأمير معن بن زائدة،
english_before: He was taking some to Ma‘an,
english_after: He wanted to give them as a gift to Prince Ma'an bin Zaidah,
note: gift to the prince, not 'taking some'

arabic: لأنه سمع كثيرًا عن كرمه مع الغرباء.
english_before: whose generosity he had heard about.
english_after: because he had heard much about his generosity to strangers.

arabic: سأله معن، من غير أن يكشف عن هويته:
english_before: Without revealing himself,
english_after: Ma'an asked him, without revealing who he was:

arabic: «كم تتوقع أن يعطيك الأمير؟»
english_before: Ma‘an asked what reward he expected.
english_after: "How much do you expect the prince to give you?"

arabic: أجاب الأعرابي: «ألف دينار».
english_before: “A thousand dinars,” said the Bedouin.
english_after: “A thousand dinars,” said the Bedouin.

arabic: قال معن: «وإن رأى أن المبلغ كبير؟» فقال: «خمسمئة».
english_before: “And if that is too much?” “Five hundred.”
english_after: Ma'an said: "And if he thinks that is too much?" He said: "Five hundred."

arabic: استمر معن يسأله، فنزل الأعرابي إلى ثلاثمئة،
english_before: Ma‘an kept asking, and the Bedouin reduced the price
english_after: Ma'an kept questioning him, and the Bedouin came down to three hundred,

arabic: ثم مئتين، ثم مئة، ثم خمسين، وأخيرًا ثلاثين دينارًا.
english_before: through three hundred, two hundred, one hundred, fifty and thirty.
english_after: then two hundred, then one hundred, then fifty, and finally thirty dinars.

arabic: قال بعدها إنه لن ينزل أكثر،
english_before: Below that,
english_after: After that he said he would go no lower,

arabic: وإلا دخل بحماره بيت الأمير وعاد خائبًا.
english_before: he threatened to bring his donkey into the prince’s house.
english_after: or else he would bring his donkey into the prince's house and go home empty-handed.

arabic: ضحك معن وسبق الأعرابي إلى قصره.
english_before: Ma‘an laughed, rode back to his palace
english_after: Ma'an laughed and rode ahead of the Bedouin to his palace,

arabic: أوصى الحارس أن يدخل رجلًا يأتي بالخيار على حمار.
english_before: and told the guard to admit a man bringing cucumbers on a donkey.
english_after: and told the guard to admit a man bringing cucumbers on a donkey.

arabic: وبعد قليل وصل الأعرابي،
english_before: The Bedouin arrived
english_after: A little later the Bedouin arrived

arabic: فرأى الأمير جالسًا على عرشه وبين يديه الخدم والرجال.
english_before: and saw the prince on his throne.
english_after: and saw the prince seated on his throne, with servants and men before him.

arabic: لم يعرفه الأعرابي في البداية، وقدم له الخيار.
english_before: The Bedouin did not recognize him at first.
english_after: At first the Bedouin did not recognize him, and he offered him the cucumbers.

arabic: سأله الأمير عن الثمن، فطلب ألف دينار.
english_before: He offered the cucumbers and asked for a thousand dinars.
english_after: The prince asked the price, and he asked for a thousand dinars.
note: omitted the prince asking the price

arabic: أخذ معن يرفض كل مبلغ،
english_before: Ma‘an bargained him down
english_after: Ma'an kept refusing every amount,

arabic: حتى وصل الأعرابي مرة أخرى إلى ثلاثين دينارًا ورفض النزول أكثر.
english_before: again to thirty.
english_after: until the Bedouin again reached thirty dinars and refused to go lower.

arabic: فجأة عرف الأعرابي أن الأمير هو الرجل الذي قابله في الصحراء.
english_before: Suddenly recognizing the hunter,
english_after: Suddenly the Bedouin realized the prince was the man he had met in the desert.

arabic: قال ضاحكًا: «إذا لم تعطِني الثلاثين،
english_before: the Bedouin joked that his donkey was waiting outside,
english_after: He said, laughing: "If you don't give me the thirty,

arabic: فحماري مربوط عند الباب، وسيدخل بيتك كما وعدت!»
english_before: ready to enter the palace.
english_after: my donkey is tied at the door, and it will come into your house as I promised!"

arabic: فضحك معن حتى مال إلى الخلف.
english_before: Ma‘an laughed heartily.
english_after: Ma'an laughed so hard he leaned back.

arabic: نادى معن أمين ماله،
english_before: Ma‘an ordered payment
english_after: Ma'an called his treasurer

arabic: وأمره أن يعطي الأعرابي كل المبالغ التي ذكرها، لا آخر مبلغ فقط.
english_before: of every amount named, not merely thirty.
english_after: and ordered him to give the Bedouin every amount he had named, not just the last one.

arabic: جمع الرجل ألفًا وخمسمئة وثلاثمئة ومئتين ومئة وخمسين وثلاثين دينارًا،
english_before: The Bedouin received 2,180 dinars in total
english_after: The man collected one thousand, five hundred, three hundred, two hundred, one hundred, fifty and thirty dinars,
note: listed amounts replaced by a total

arabic: وعاد متعجبًا بثروة كبيرة.
english_before: and returned home amazed by his fortune.
english_after: and went home amazed, with a great fortune.

arabic: لم يستطع الخليفة هارون الرشيد النوم ذات ليلة،
english_before: One sleepless night Caliph Harun al-Rashid
english_after: One night Caliph Harun al-Rashid could not sleep,

arabic: فطلب من وزيره جعفر قصة تضحكه وتخفف عنه الهم.
english_before: asked Ja’far for an amusing story.
english_after: so he asked his vizier Ja'far for a story to make him laugh and ease his worries.

arabic: اقترح جعفر استدعاء رجل يعرف الحكايات الطريفة اسمه علي الفارسي،
english_before: Ja’far brought Ali the Persian,
english_after: Ja'far suggested sending for a man who knew funny tales, named Ali the Persian,

arabic: فحضر علي وجلس أمام الخليفة.
english_before: a man known for entertaining tales.
english_after: so Ali came and sat before the caliph.

arabic: قال علي إنه سافر يومًا يحمل كيسًا جلديًا صغيرًا فيه زاده.
english_before: Ali recalled traveling with a small leather bag of provisions.
english_after: Ali recalled traveling with a small leather bag of provisions.

arabic: وبينما كان يشتري من سوق مدينة غريبة،
english_before: At a market,
english_after: While he was shopping in the market of a strange city,

arabic: أمسك به رجل كردي وانتزع الكيس منه،
english_before: a Kurdish stranger seized it
english_after: a Kurdish man grabbed him and snatched the bag from him,

arabic: وادعى أمام الناس أنه صاحبه الحقيقي.
english_before: and loudly claimed ownership.
english_after: and claimed before the people that he was its true owner.

arabic: احتكم الخصمان إلى القاضي،
english_before: They appeared before a judge,
english_after: They appeared before a judge,

arabic: فسأل المدعي عن محتويات الكيس. بدأ الرجل يعدد أشياء معقولة،
english_before: who asked the claimant to describe the contents.
english_after: who asked the claimant what was in the bag. The man began listing reasonable items,

arabic: ثم زعم أن فيه خيمتين وبساطين وبقرة وعجلين
english_before: The man listed tents, rugs, cattle,
english_after: then claimed it held two tents, two rugs, a cow and two calves,

arabic: وأغنامًا وجمالًا وسباعًا، بل وغرفًا كاملة داخل الكيس الصغير.
english_before: camels, wild beasts, and even rooms.
english_after: sheep, camels and wild beasts, and even whole rooms inside the little bag.

arabic: صُعق علي من المبالغة، لكنه رد بمبالغة أكبر.
english_before: Astonished, Ali retaliated with a grander inventory:
english_after: Ali was stunned by the exaggeration, but answered with a bigger one.

arabic: قال إن كيسه يحوي بيتًا قديمًا ومدرسة وحديقة
english_before: houses, a school, gardens,
english_after: He said his bag held an old house, a school and a garden,

arabic: ومدينة بغداد ومدينة البصرة، وجيوشًا من الجنود،
english_before: Baghdad, Basra, armies,
english_after: the cities of Baghdad and Basra, armies of soldiers,

arabic: وآلاف الناس الذين يشهدون أنه ملكه.
english_before: and thousands of witnesses—all supposedly in his bag.
english_after: and thousands of people who would testify that it was his.

arabic: نفد صبر القاضي، وقال إن أحدًا لم يسمع قط ادعاءات بهذه الغرابة.
english_before: The judge finally asked
english_after: The judge lost patience and said no one had ever heard such strange claims.

arabic: سأل الرجلين: هل هذا الكيس بحر بلا قرار
english_before: whether this was a bottomless sea
english_after: He asked the two men: is this bag a bottomless sea

arabic: أم مكان يجتمع فيه الناس جميعًا؟
english_before: or a place containing all humanity.
english_after: or a place where all people gather?

arabic: ثم أمرهما بفتحه أمام المجلس.
english_before: He ordered the bag opened before the court.
english_after: He ordered the bag opened before the court.

arabic: فتح علي الكيس، فلم يجد فيه أحد مدينة ولا حيوانًا ولا جيشًا.
english_before: The bag contained no cities or animals—only
english_after: Ali opened the bag, and no one found a city, an animal or an army in it.
note: em dash; omitted Ali opening it, armies

arabic: لم يكن داخله إلا خبز وقليل من الجبن وزيتون وحبة ليمون.
english_before: bread, cheese, olives, and a lemon.
english_after: Inside there was only bread, a little cheese, olives and a lemon.

arabic: ألقى علي الكيس أمام خصمه وانصرف، تاركًا القاضي يواجه سخافة النزاع.
english_before: Ali dropped it before his rival and walked away.
english_after: Ali threw the bag before his opponent and left, leaving the judge to face the absurd dispute.

arabic: انفجر هارون الرشيد ضاحكًا حين وصل علي إلى نهاية قصته،
english_before: Harun al-Rashid laughed heartily at the ending
english_after: Harun al-Rashid burst out laughing when Ali reached the end of his story,

arabic: وأعطاه هدية سخية.
english_before: and rewarded Ali.
english_after: and gave him a generous gift.

arabic: وهكذا انتهت خصومة الكيس الصغير، لا بحكم معقد،
english_before: A simple inspection
english_after: So the quarrel over the little bag ended, not with a complicated ruling,

arabic: بل بكشف بسيط فضح ادعاءين لا يمكن تصديقهما.
english_before: had exposed both men’s absurd claims.
english_after: but with a simple look inside that exposed two unbelievable claims.

arabic: أمر الخليفة هارون الرشيد أحد حراسه، واسمه صالح،
english_before: Caliph Harun ordered his guard Salih
english_after: Caliph Harun al-Rashid ordered one of his guards, named Salih,

arabic: أن يأخذ من رجل يدعى منصور مليون درهم قبل غروب الشمس.
english_before: to collect a million dirhams from Mansur before sunset,
english_after: to collect a million dirhams from Mansur before sunset,

arabic: وقال إن لم يدفع المال في الوقت المحدد، فسيعاقب عقابًا شديدًا.
english_before: threatening severe punishment if the money did not arrive.
english_after: saying that if he did not pay on time, he would be severely punished.

arabic: لم يكن لدى منصور إلا جزء صغير من المبلغ،
english_before: Mansur possessed only a small part of the sum.
english_after: Mansur possessed only a small part of the sum.

arabic: فاشتد خوفه وعجز عن التفكير.
english_before: Seeing his distress,
english_after: His fear grew and he could not think.

arabic: رق له صالح، واصطحبه إلى بيت يحيى بن خالد البرمكي،
english_before: Salih took him to Yahya ibn Khalid al-Barmaki,
english_after: Salih pitied him and took him to the house of Yahya ibn Khalid al-Barmaki,

arabic: الذي اشتهر بكرمه ومساعدة المحتاجين.
english_before: a man renowned for generosity.
english_after: who was famous for his generosity and for helping the needy.

arabic: سمع يحيى القصة،
english_before: Yahya heard the story
english_after: Yahya heard the story

arabic: وطلب من خازنه أن يحضر ما عنده من نقود.
english_before: and checked his treasury,
english_after: and asked his treasurer to bring whatever money he had.

arabic: لم يجد في الخزانة إلا خمسة آلاف درهم،
english_before: finding only five thousand dirhams.
english_after: The treasury held only five thousand dirhams,

arabic: فبعث يطلب العون من ابنيه الفضل وجعفر دون تأخير.
english_before: He immediately asked his sons al-Fadl and Jaafar for help.
english_after: so he sent at once to his sons al-Fadl and Jaafar for help.

arabic: أرسل كل واحد من الابنين مبلغًا كبيرًا،
english_before: Each son sent a large sum,
english_after: Each son sent a large sum,

arabic: فصار لدى يحيى ما يكفي لسداد الدين وزيادة.
english_before: enough to cover the debt and more.
english_after: enough to cover the debt and more.

arabic: وأضاف إلى المال جوهرة نفيسة كان لها تاريخ معروف في مجلس الخليفة،
english_before: Yahya added a valuable jewel familiar at the caliph’s court
english_after: He added to the money a precious jewel with a well-known history at the caliph's court

arabic: وسلم الجميع إلى منصور.
english_before: and handed everything to Mansur.
english_after: and handed everything to Mansur.

arabic: شكر منصور يحيى،
english_before: Mansur thanked Yahya
english_after: Mansur thanked Yahya

arabic: ثم خرج مع صالح يحمل المال والجوهرة.
english_before: and departed with Salih.
english_after: then left with Salih, carrying the money and the jewel.

arabic: وكان يحيى يأمل أن يتعرف الخليفة إلى الجوهرة،
english_before: Yahya hoped the caliph would recognize the jewel,
english_after: Yahya hoped the caliph would recognize the jewel,

arabic: فيدرك مقدار المساعدة التي قدمها، فيلين قلبه تجاه الرجل المديون.
english_before: understand his generosity, and show mercy to the debtor.
english_after: and so realize how much help he had given, and soften his heart toward the debtor.

arabic: لكن منصور، وقد غلبه الخوف،
english_before: Yet on the way
english_after: But Mansur, overcome by fear,

arabic: أنشد في الطريق أبياتًا أوحت بأنه لم يلجأ إلى المحسن إلا مضطرًا.
english_before: Mansur recited verses suggesting he had sought help only from fear.
english_after: recited verses on the way suggesting he had turned to his benefactor only out of need.

arabic: استنكر صالح كلامه،
english_before: Salih rebuked him
english_after: Salih rebuked him

arabic: وقال إن هذا جزاء سيئ لمن أنقذه من الهلاك.
english_before: for such ingratitude toward the man who had saved him.
english_after: and said it was a poor reward for the man who had saved him from ruin.

arabic: رفع صالح إلى الخليفة المال والجوهرة، وأخبره كذلك بما قاله منصور.
english_before: Salih presented the money and jewel and reported Mansur’s words.
english_after: Salih brought the money and the jewel to the caliph, and also told him what Mansur had said.

arabic: عرف هارون الجوهرة،
english_before: Harun recognized the jewel,
english_after: Harun recognized the jewel,

arabic: وتأثر بكرم يحيى،
english_before: was moved by Yahya’s kindness,
english_after: was moved by Yahya’s kindness,

arabic: فأعادها إليه. وبلغ يحيى أيضًا خبر كلام الرجل بعد أن ساعده.
english_before: and returned it to him.
english_after: and returned it to him. Yahya also heard what the man had said after he helped him.
note: omitted Yahya hearing of the words

arabic: لم يغضب يحيى من منصور،
english_before: Yahya did not resent Mansur.
english_after: Yahya did not resent Mansur.

arabic: بل قال إن الخوف والحزن قد يجعلان الإنسان يقول ما لا يريد.
english_before: He said fear and sorrow can make a person speak badly.
english_after: Instead he said fear and grief can make a person say what he does not mean.

arabic: وهكذا انتهت المحنة،
english_before: The crisis ended,
english_after: The crisis ended,

arabic: وبقي موقف يحيى شاهدًا على كرم لا ينتظر الشكر.
english_before: and his generosity stood without any demand for gratitude.
english_after: and Yahya's stand remained a testament to generosity that expects no thanks.

arabic: كان رجل فقير من العراق
english_before: A poor Iraqi man
english_after: A poor Iraqi man

arabic: يبحث عن وسيلة يخرج بها من ضيق العيش.
english_before: sought a way out of hardship.
english_after: sought a way out of hardship.

arabic: سمع عن والي أرمينية عبد الله بن مالك،
english_before: He heard of Abdullah ibn Malik, governor of Armenia,
english_after: He heard of Abdullah ibn Malik, governor of Armenia,

arabic: وعن خلاف قديم بينه وبين الوزير يحيى بن خالد البرمكي.
english_before: and his long-standing quarrel with Yahya al-Barmaki.
english_after: and of an old quarrel between him and the vizier Yahya ibn Khalid al-Barmaki.

arabic: كتب الرجل رسالة مزورة،
english_before: The man forged a letter
english_after: The man forged a letter

arabic: وجعلها كأنها من يحيى إلى الوالي، يطلب فيها إكرام حاملها ومساعدته.
english_before: supposedly from Yahya requesting help for its bearer.
english_after: made to look as if from Yahya to the governor, asking him to honor and help its bearer.

arabic: ثم سافر مسافة طويلة،
english_before: After a long journey,
english_after: After a long journey,

arabic: ودخل على عبد الله وقدم إليه الرسالة بثقة.
english_before: he presented it confidently to Governor Abdullah.
english_after: he presented it confidently to Governor Abdullah.

arabic: قرأ عبد الله الخطاب، وشك في صحته،
english_before: Abdullah doubted the letter
english_after: Abdullah read the letter and doubted it was genuine,

arabic: لأنه يعرف الخصومة التي بينه وبين يحيى.
english_before: because of his feud with Yahya.
english_after: because of his feud with Yahya.

english_before: He promised a great reward if it was genuine,
english_after: He told the man: if the letter is genuine, I will honor you,

arabic: وإن كانت كذبًا فلك عقاب شديد.
english_before: but severe punishment if it was false.
english_after: but if it is a lie, you will be severely punished.

arabic: أقام الرجل عند الوالي ينتظر النتيجة،
english_before: The man waited
english_after: The man stayed with the governor, awaiting the outcome,

arabic: بينما أرسل عبد الله رسولًا إلى بغداد ليسأل يحيى بنفسه.
english_before: while Abdullah sent an envoy to Baghdad.
english_after: while Abdullah sent a messenger to Baghdad to ask Yahya himself.

arabic: مرت الأيام ثقيلة على الرجل؛
english_before: Each day felt long:
english_after: The days weighed heavily on the man,

english_before: Yahya’s answer could bring him wealth or expose him to a humiliating beating.
english_after: for the answer could bring him wealth, or expose him to beating and humiliation.

english_before: Yahya immediately recognized the forgery.
english_after: Yahya understood when he read the letter, and knew he had not written it.

arabic: لكنه رأى فيها فرصة لإنهاء العداوة،
english_before: Yet he saw a chance for peace
english_after: But he saw in it a chance to end the hostility,

arabic: فقال للرسول إنها رسالته حقًا،
english_before: and told the envoy the letter was indeed his,
english_after: and told the envoy the letter was indeed his,

arabic: وأوصى الوالي بأن يحسن معاملة حاملها.
english_before: urging Abdullah to honor its bearer.
english_after: urging Abdullah to honor its bearer.

arabic: فرح عبد الله بهذا الجواب، وأعطى الرجل مئتي ألف درهم،
english_before: Delighted, Abdullah gave the man two hundred thousand dirhams,
english_after: Delighted, Abdullah gave the man two hundred thousand dirhams,

english_before: ten Arabian horses, chests of clothes, servants and jewels.
english_after: ten Arabian horses, chests of clothes, servants and jewels.

english_before: Back in Baghdad, the astonished man
english_after: The man returned to Baghdad, hardly believing what had happened.

english_before: admitted his trick to Yahya,
english_after: He went to Yahya and confessed what he had done,

english_before: thanked him for saving him from punishment,
english_after: thanked him for saving him from punishment,

english_before: and offered him part of his gifts.

english_before: Yahya refused.

arabic: وقال إن الرجل كان سببًا في الصلح بين صديقين تفرقا.
english_before: The visitor had brought peace between two estranged men, he said.
english_after: saying the man had brought about peace between two friends who had fallen out.

arabic: ثم زاده من ماله وخيله مثل ما ناله،
english_before: Yahya then matched the wealth and horses the man had received,
english_after: Then he gave him as much of his own wealth and horses as the man had received,

arabic: فخرج الفقير بغنيمتين بدل واحدة.
english_before: doubling his reward.
english_after: so the poor man left with two rewards instead of one.

arabic: كان الخليفة المأمون يحب العلم،
english_before: Caliph al-Maamun loved learning
english_after: Caliph al-Maamun loved learning

english_before: and assembled scholars twice a week.
english_after: and gathered scholars twice a week to debate difficult questions.

english_after: At one gathering a stranger who looked poor came in

english_before: and sat far from the others.
english_after: and sat far from the others.

arabic: لم يلتفت إليه أكثر الحاضرين،
english_before: Few noticed him,
english_after: Few noticed him,

english_after: assuming his simple clothing meant little education.
