arabic: عجز بعض العلماء عن الإجابة عنه إجابة واضحة ومقنعة.
english_before: that several scholars could not answer clearly.
english_after: that some scholars could not answer clearly and convincingly.

arabic: رفع الغريب يده بهدوء، واستأذن في الكلام.
english_before: The stranger asked permission to speak.
english_after: The stranger calmly raised his hand and asked permission to speak.

arabic: ثم قدم جوابًا دقيقًا، وشرح أسبابه بألفاظ سهلة.
english_before: His precise, plainly explained answer
english_after: Then he gave a precise answer and explained his reasons in simple words.

arabic: أعجب المأمون بفهمه،
english_before: impressed al-Maamun,
english_after: Al-Maamun was impressed by his understanding

arabic: ودعاه إلى الجلوس في مكان أقرب إلى العلماء.
english_before: who invited him to sit nearer the scholars.
english_after: and invited him to sit closer to the scholars.

arabic: جاء سؤال ثان، فاختلف الحاضرون في تفسيره.
english_before: A second question divided the gathering.
english_after: A second question came, and those present disagreed on its meaning.

arabic: تكلم الرجل مرة أخرى، وجمع بين الأدلة حتى اتضح المعنى.
english_before: The stranger weighed the evidence and clarified the answer.
english_after: The man spoke again, bringing the evidence together until the meaning was clear.

arabic: أشار الخليفة إليه أن يتقدم،
english_before: The caliph moved him closer still,
english_after: The caliph signaled him to come forward,

arabic: وأصبح موضع اهتمام من كانوا يتجاهلونه.
english_before: and those who ignored him took notice.
english_after: and he drew the attention of those who had ignored him.

arabic: وفي السؤال الثالث أظهر الغريب علمًا أوسع مما توقعه الجميع،
english_before: His third answer surpassed expectations.
english_after: On the third question the stranger showed more knowledge than anyone expected,

arabic: فدعاه المأمون للجلوس إلى جانبه.
english_before: Al-Maamun invited him beside him.
english_after: so al-Maamun invited him to sit beside him.

arabic: عند انتهاء المناظرة، جلسوا إلى الطعام،
english_before: After the debate, the company ate together,
english_after: When the debate ended, they sat down to eat,

arabic: وصار الرجل ضيفًا مكرمًا بدل الغريب المنسي.
english_before: and the forgotten stranger became an honored guest.
english_after: and the forgotten stranger became an honored guest.

arabic: ثم انتقل المجلس إلى الشراب،
english_before: The gathering then turned to drinking.
english_after: The gathering then turned to drinking.

arabic: وعرض الخليفة على ضيفه كأسًا من الخمر كما كان يفعل مع بعض جلسائه.
english_before: The caliph offered his guest a cup of wine.
english_after: The caliph offered his guest a cup of wine, as he did with some of his companions.

arabic: اعتذر الرجل بأدب، ولم يتناول الكأس،
english_before: The man politely refused,
english_after: The man politely declined and did not take the cup,

arabic: فتعجب المأمون وسأله عن السبب.
english_before: and al-Maamun asked him why.
english_after: and al-Maamun, surprised, asked him why.

arabic: أجاب العالم: يا أمير المؤمنين،
english_before: The scholar replied:
english_after: The scholar answered: Commander of the Faithful,

arabic: لم تقربني منك ثيابي ولا مالي، بل عقلي وعلمي.
english_before: It was neither wealth nor clothing that brought me near you, but my mind and knowledge.
english_after: neither my clothes nor my wealth brought me near you, but my mind and knowledge.

arabic: فإذا شربت ما يذهب عقلي،
english_before: Why drink something
english_after: If I drink what takes away my mind,

arabic: فقد أفسدت الشيء الذي رفعني في مجلسك هذا اليوم.
english_before: that could take away what earned your respect?
english_after: I will ruin the very thing that raised me in your court today.

arabic: سر الخليفة بجوابه أكثر من سروره بأجوبته العلمية،
english_before: The caliph admired this answer even more
english_after: The caliph was more pleased with this answer than with his learned answers,

arabic: وأمر له بمئة ألف قطعة من الفضة.
english_before: and awarded him one hundred thousand silver coins.
english_after: and awarded him one hundred thousand silver coins.

arabic: خرج الرجل مكرمًا،
english_before: The scholar departed honored,
english_after: The scholar departed honored,

arabic: بعدما حفظ بعلمه مكانته، ثم حفظ بعقله سبب تلك المكانة.
english_before: having protected the very reason for his rise.
english_after: having kept his place through his knowledge, then kept the reason for that place through his mind.

arabic: كان رجل غريب قد أثقلته الديون،
english_before: A stranger burdened by debt
english_after: A stranger burdened by debt

arabic: ولم يجد عملًا ولا طعامًا يكفيه.
english_before: had neither work nor enough food.
english_after: had neither work nor enough food.

arabic: وبينما يمشي في مدينة كبيرة، رأى جماعة تدخل قصرًا واسعًا،
english_before: He followed a group entering a grand mansion,
english_after: Walking through a big city, he saw a group entering a large palace,

arabic: فتبعها على أمل أن يجد شيئًا يأكله.
english_before: hoping he might find something to eat.
english_after: and followed them, hoping to find something to eat.

arabic: دخل مع الزائرين دون أن ينتبه إليه أحد،
english_before: He slipped inside unnoticed
english_after: He slipped inside unnoticed

arabic: ثم جلس في زاوية من الفناء.
english_before: and sat in a corner.
english_after: then sat in a corner of the courtyard.

arabic: رأى أربعة كلاب كبيرة تلبس أطواقًا من ذهب،
english_before: Four large dogs wore golden collars
english_after: He saw four large dogs wearing gold collars,

arabic: وتربطها سلاسل من فضة، وأمامها أطباق ذهبية.
english_before: and silver chains, with solid gold dishes set before them.
english_after: tied with silver chains, with gold dishes in front of them.

arabic: وضع الخدم الطعام للكلاب،
english_before: Servants brought food for the dogs,
english_after: Servants brought food for the dogs,

arabic: لكن الرجل كان أشد جوعًا منها.
english_before: but the man was hungrier than they were.
english_after: but the man was hungrier than they were.

arabic: لاحظه أحد الكلاب، فنظر إليه طويلًا،
english_before: One dog watched him,
english_after: One of the dogs noticed him and looked at him for a long time,

arabic: ثم ابتعد عن طبقه كأنه يدعوه إلى الاقتراب وتناول شيء من الطعام.
english_before: then stepped aside as if inviting him to eat.
english_after: then stepped aside as if inviting him to eat.

arabic: تردد الرجل أولًا، ثم اقترب وأكل حتى زال جوعه.
english_before: He hesitated, then ate until satisfied.
english_after: He hesitated, then ate until satisfied.

arabic: لم يمنعه الكلب،
english_before: The dog did not stop him;
english_after: The dog did not stop him;

arabic: بل دفع نحوه الطبق الذهبي بقدمه،
english_before: it pushed its golden dish toward him with a paw,
english_after: it pushed its golden dish toward him with a paw,

arabic: وكأنه يقول له: خذ هذا أيضًا، فلعلك تحتاج إليه أكثر مني.
english_before: as though offering that too.
english_after: as if saying: take this too, perhaps you need it more than I do.

arabic: أخذ الرجل الطبق وخرج من القصر، ثم باعه بثمن كبير.
english_before: He took the dish, sold it for a great price,
english_after: The man took the dish, left the palace, and sold it for a high price.

arabic: سدد بعض ديونه، واشترى بماله بضاعة يتاجر بها.
english_before: paid debts, and invested in trade.
english_after: He paid off some of his debts and bought goods to trade with.

arabic: ومع مرور السنوات نجحت تجارته،
english_before: Over the years his business prospered,
english_after: Over the years his business prospered,

arabic: وأصبح قادرًا على العيش في سعة.
english_before: and he became wealthy.
english_after: and he was able to live in comfort.

arabic: لم ينس الرجل الكلب ولا صاحب القصر.
english_before: He never forgot the dog or its owner.
english_after: He never forgot the dog or its owner.

arabic: وبعد سنوات عاد يحمل مالًا يعادل قيمة الطبق وهدايا أخرى، يريد رد الجميل.
english_before: Years later he returned with repayment and gifts,
english_after: Years later he returned with money equal to the dish's value and other gifts, to repay the kindness.
note: omitted value of dish, repaying kindness

arabic: لكنه وجد المكان خربًا،
english_before: only to find the mansion ruined
english_after: but he found the place in ruins,

arabic: وقد اختفى ما كان فيه من غنى.
english_before: and its former splendor gone.
english_after: and all its wealth gone.

arabic: سأل عن صاحب القصر،
english_before: He found the former owner
english_after: He asked about the owner of the palace,

arabic: فدلوه على رجل فقير يعيش في ضيق. عرف أنه المالك نفسه،
english_before: living in poverty.
english_after: and was directed to a poor man living in hardship. He recognized him as the owner himself,

arabic: فأخبره كيف أنقذه طبق الكلب من الجوع والدين،
english_before: The visitor explained how the dog’s dish had saved him from hunger and debt,
english_after: and told him how the dog's dish had saved him from hunger and debt,

arabic: وقدم إليه المال شاكرًا ومعتذرًا.
english_before: then offered the money with thanks.
english_after: and offered him the money with thanks and apologies.

arabic: رفض الرجل الفقير أن يأخذ شيئًا،
english_before: The impoverished owner refused:
english_after: The poor man refused to take anything,

arabic: وقال: لم أعطك الطبق، بل أعطاك إياه كلبي،
english_before: His dog had given the dish,
english_after: and said: I did not give you the dish, my dog gave it to you,

arabic: ولا آخذ ثمن هدية قدمها غيري.
english_before: and he would not charge for another’s gift.
english_after: and I will not take payment for a gift someone else gave.

arabic: انصرف الزائر متعجبًا من عزة نفس لم تضعف مع الفقر.
english_before: The visitor left amazed by dignity that poverty could not diminish.
english_after: The visitor left amazed by dignity that poverty could not diminish.

arabic: دخل جندي مدينة الإسكندرية ونزل في خان للمسافرين،
english_before: A soldier arrived in Alexandria
english_after: A soldier arrived in Alexandria and stayed at an inn for travelers,

arabic: وكان يحمل كيسًا فيه ألف قطعة ذهبية.
english_before: with a purse of a thousand gold pieces.
english_after: with a purse of a thousand gold pieces.

arabic: نام بعض الليل، ثم استيقظ ليجد حقيبته ممزقة والمال مسروقًا.
english_before: Overnight someone cut open his saddlebags and stole it,
english_after: He slept part of the night, then woke to find his bag slit open and the money stolen.

arabic: أسرع إلى رئيس الشرطة حسام الدين يشكو ما حدث.
english_before: so he complained to Husam al-Din, the police chief.
english_after: He hurried to the police chief, Husam al-Din, to report what had happened.

arabic: أمر رئيس الشرطة بالقبض على جميع من كانوا في الخان،
english_before: The chief detained everyone at the inn
english_after: The police chief ordered everyone at the inn arrested,

arabic: مع أنهم لم يُتهموا بدليل واضح.
english_before: and prepared to beat them
english_after: though there was no clear evidence against them.

arabic: وفي الصباح أحضر العصي استعدادًا لضربهم حتى يعترف أحدهم،
english_before: into a confession,
english_after: In the morning he brought out sticks to beat them until one of them confessed,

arabic: بينما وقف الجندي ينتظر استعادة نقوده.
english_before: despite lacking proof against any one guest.
english_after: while the soldier stood waiting to get his money back.

arabic: قبل بدء الضرب شق رجل طريقه بين الحاضرين
english_before: Before the beating began,
english_after: Before the beating began, a man pushed his way through the crowd

arabic: وصاح: دعوا هؤلاء الأبرياء، فأنا الذي أخذت المال!
english_before: a stranger stepped forward, confessed,
english_after: and shouted: Let these innocent people go, I am the one who took the money!

arabic: أخرج كيس الذهب من كمه ووضعه أمام رئيس الشرطة والجندي،
english_before: and placed the purse before the chief.
english_after: He took the purse of gold from his sleeve and set it before the police chief and the soldier,

arabic: فتنفس المسافرون المحبوسون الصعداء.
english_before: The detained travelers were relieved.
english_after: The detained travelers were relieved.

arabic: أثنى الناس على اعتراف الرجل،
english_before: People praised the confession,
english_after: People praised the confession,

arabic: لكنه قال إن براعته الحقيقية ليست في إعادة المال،
english_before: but the man boasted that his cleverest feat
english_after: but he said his real skill was not in returning the money,

arabic: بل في سرقته مرة ثانية.
english_before: was stealing the purse a second time.
english_after: but in stealing it a second time.

arabic: سأله رئيس الشرطة بدهشة كيف فعل ذلك، فبدأ المحتال يروي طريقته من البداية.
english_before: The chief demanded an explanation.
english_after: Amazed, the police chief asked how he had done it, and the trickster began explaining from the start.

arabic: قال المحتال إنه رأى الجندي يستلم الذهب في سوق الصيارفة بالقاهرة.
english_before: The trickster said he had watched the soldier receive the gold in Cairo
english_after: The trickster said he had seen the soldier receive the gold at the money changers' market in Cairo.

arabic: تبعه من مدينة إلى أخرى دون أن يجد فرصة للسرقة،
english_before: and followed him from town to town,
english_after: He followed him from city to city without finding a chance to steal it,

arabic: حتى نزل معه في خان الإسكندرية وراقبه إلى أن غلبه النوم.
english_before: waiting for an opportunity.
english_after: until he stayed at the same inn in Alexandria and watched him until he fell asleep.

arabic: شرح كيف شق حقيبة الجندي ليلًا وأخذ المال بهدوء.
english_before: He described cutting the sleeping soldier’s bag.
english_after: He explained how he had slit the soldier's bag at night and quietly taken the money.

arabic: ثم مد يده نحو الكيس الموضوع على الطاولة وقال إنه سيُريهم الحركة نفسها.
english_before: Pretending to demonstrate the theft,
english_after: Then he reached for the purse on the table, saying he would show them the very same move.

arabic: اقترب الجميع ليتابعوا العرض،
english_before: he reached for the purse
english_after: Everyone drew closer to watch the show,

arabic: وهم يظنون أن المال أصبح في أمان.
english_before: lying openly before them.
english_after: thinking the money was now safe.

arabic: أمسك الكيس فجأة واندفع خارج المجلس،
english_before: Suddenly he grabbed the purse, ran outside,
english_after: Suddenly he grabbed the purse and dashed out of the hall,

arabic: ثم قفز في بركة ماء قريبة
english_before: plunged into a nearby pool,
english_after: plunged into a nearby pool,

arabic: وفر عبر أزقة الإسكندرية المتصلة.
english_before: and escaped through Alexandria’s interconnected lanes.
english_after: and escaped through Alexandria’s interconnected lanes.

arabic: صرخ رئيس الشرطة يأمر بملاحقته، لكن الرجال تأخروا، وعادوا من دون المحتال أو المال.
english_before: The officers failed to catch him.
english_after: The police chief shouted for a chase, but his men were too slow and came back without the trickster or the money.

arabic: قال رئيس الشرطة للجندي إنه وجد اللص واستعاد ماله للحظة،
english_before: The chief insisted the soldier had briefly recovered his money
english_after: The police chief told the soldier he had found the thief and got his money back for a moment,

arabic: ولذلك لم يعد يستطيع مطالبة أهل الخان بشيء.
english_before: and could not blame the inn guests.
english_after: so he could no longer claim anything from the people of the inn.

arabic: خرج الجندي خالي اليدين، ونجا المسافرون من الضرب.
english_before: The soldier lost his gold, the innocents were spared,
english_after: The soldier left empty-handed, and the travelers escaped the beating.

arabic: أما المحتال فهرب، تاركًا خلفه فضيحة لرئيس الشرطة.
english_before: and the thief escaped.
english_after: As for the trickster, he escaped, leaving the police chief disgraced.

arabic: كان علاء الدين رئيس الشرطة في مدينة قوص،
english_before: Ala al-Din, chief of police in Kus,
english_after: Ala al-Din, chief of police in Kus,

arabic: يجلس في بيته ذات مساء حين جاءه رجل حسن الثياب والهيئة.
english_before: was at home one evening when a well-dressed stranger arrived
english_after: was sitting at home one evening when a well-dressed, distinguished-looking man came to him.

arabic: وقف خلفه خادم يحمل صندوقًا ثقيلًا،
english_before: with a servant carrying a heavy chest
english_after: Behind him stood a servant carrying a heavy chest,

arabic: وطلب الزائر مقابلة الرئيس في أمر سري.
english_before: and requested a private meeting.
english_after: and the visitor asked to meet the chief on a secret matter.

arabic: رحب رئيس الشرطة بالرجل، وأجلسه إلى جانبه، وسأله عن حاجته.
english_before: The chief welcomed him.
english_after: The police chief welcomed the man, seated him at his side and asked what he needed.
note: omitted seating him and asking his need

arabic: قال الضيف إنه كان يقطع الطريق ويسرق أموال الناس،
english_before: The stranger confessed that he had robbed travelers
english_after: The guest said he used to rob on the highways and steal people's money,

arabic: لكنه يريد أن يترك تلك الحياة ويتوب، ويبدأ عملًا شريفًا.
english_before: but claimed he now wished to repent and earn an honest living.
english_after: but he wanted to leave that life, repent and start an honest living.

arabic: أشار الرجل إلى الصندوق،
english_before: Pointing to the chest,
english_after: Pointing to the chest,

arabic: وقال إن فيه حليًا وجواهر ومعادن ثمينة تساوي أربعين ألف دينار.
english_before: he claimed it held jewels and precious metal worth forty thousand dinars.
english_after: and said it held ornaments, jewels and precious metals worth forty thousand dinars.

arabic: فتح الغطاء، فظهرت أشياء لامعة،
english_before: He opened it to reveal gleaming ornaments,
english_after: He opened the lid, and gleaming things appeared,

arabic: وخواتم كبيرة، وأحجار براقة، فتعجب رئيس الشرطة من كثرتها.
english_before: rings and sparkling stones.
english_after: large rings and sparkling stones, and the police chief marveled at how many there were.

arabic: قال الزائر إنه لا يريد الاحتفاظ بهذه الأشياء التي حصل عليها في حياته الماضية.
english_before: He said he wanted none of the goods from his former life.
english_after: The visitor said he did not want to keep these things he had gained in his past life.

arabic: وعرض أن يسلم الصندوق كله للرئيس مقابل ألف دينار من مال حلال،
english_before: He offered the whole chest for a thousand honestly earned dinars
english_after: He offered to hand the whole chest to the chief for a thousand dinars of lawful money,

arabic: يبدأ بها تجارة جديدة تعينه على الاستقامة.
english_before: to start a lawful trade.
english_after: with which to start a new trade that would help him stay honest.

arabic: أعجب رئيس الشرطة بما ظنه توبة صادقة،
english_before: Pleased by the apparent repentance
english_after: The police chief was impressed by what he took for sincere repentance,

arabic: وسر أيضًا بما بدا له من ربح كبير.
english_before: and the apparent bargain,
english_after: and was also pleased by what looked like a big profit.

arabic: نادى خازنه وأمره بإحضار ألف دينار،
english_before: the chief ordered his treasurer to bring a thousand dinars.
english_after: He called his treasurer and ordered him to bring a thousand dinars,

arabic: فدفعها إلى الرجل، وتسلم منه الصندوق في الحال.
english_before: He paid the stranger and accepted the chest.
english_after: paid it to the man and received the chest from him at once.

arabic: شكر الرجل رئيس الشرطة، ووعده أن يذكر فضله،
english_before: The stranger thanked him
english_after: The man thanked the police chief and promised to remember his kindness,
note: omitted promise to remember his kindness

arabic: ثم خرج مع خادمه في الليل.
english_before: and left with his servant under cover of night.
english_after: and left with his servant under cover of night.

arabic: بقي الصندوق عند الرئيس، الذي لم يفحص ما فيه جيدًا،
english_before: The chief kept the chest without testing its contents
english_after: The chest stayed with the chief, who had not examined its contents closely,

arabic: وفضل أن ينتظر الصباح لعرضه على أهل الخبرة.
english_before: and waited until morning for an expert.
english_after: preferring to wait until morning to show it to experts.

arabic: في اليوم التالي استدعى أكبر الصاغة في المدينة، وطلب منه تقدير قيمة الجواهر.
english_before: The next day the chief summoned a master goldsmith.
english_after: The next day he summoned the city's leading goldsmith and asked him to value the jewels.
note: omitted request to value the jewels

arabic: فحص الصائغ الأشياء واحدة واحدة،
english_before: After examining everything,
english_after: The goldsmith examined the items one by one,

arabic: ثم أخبره أنها ليست ذهبًا ولا فضة،
english_before: the goldsmith declared the metal was brass and tin
english_after: then told him they were neither gold nor silver,
note: brass and tin belonged to next chunk

arabic: بل نحاس وقصدير وأحجار من زجاج.
english_before: and the supposed gems were only glass.
english_after: but copper, tin and stones of glass.

arabic: اشتد غضب رئيس الشرطة، وأرسل رجاله يبحثون عن الزائر،
english_before: Furious, the chief sent men after the stranger,
english_after: The police chief grew furious and sent his men to search for the visitor,

arabic: فلم يجدوا له أثرًا.
english_before: but he had vanished.
english_after: but they found no trace of him.

arabic: أدرك عندها أن المحتال لم يبع صندوق كنوز،
english_before: The supposed reformed robber
english_after: Then he realized the swindler had not sold a chest of treasure,

arabic: بل اشترى بثمن رخيص ثقة رجل كان يظن نفسه خبيرًا باللصوص.
english_before: had fooled the very official charged with catching thieves.
english_after: but had cheaply bought the trust of a man who thought himself an expert on thieves.

arabic: كان رجل صالح من بني إسرائيل
english_before: A devout Israelite
english_after: A devout Israelite

arabic: يعيش مع أسرته من غزل القطن.
english_before: supported his family by selling the cotton thread they spun.
english_after: lived with his family by spinning cotton.
note: selling thread belonged to next chunk

arabic: كانت أسرته تغزل الخيوط كل يوم، فيبيعها،
english_before: He used the proceeds
english_after: Every day his family spun thread, and he sold it,

arabic: ثم يشتري قطنًا جديدًا وطعامًا بما يبقى من المال ليكفيهم يومهم.
english_before: to buy more cotton and enough food for the day.
english_after: then bought new cotton and food with the money left, enough for that day.

arabic: وفي صباح خرج الرجل ليبيع الخيوط كما اعتاد.
english_before: One morning
english_after: One morning the man went out to sell the thread as usual.
note: omitted going out to sell thread

arabic: قابله صديق يشكو الفقر والحاجة،
english_before: a friend complained of desperate need.
english_after: He met a friend who complained of poverty and need,

arabic: فتأثر بحاله وأعطاه كل ما قبضه من ثمن الغزل،
english_before: The man gave him all the money from that day’s thread
english_after: Moved by his plight, he gave him all he had been paid for the thread,

arabic: ثم رجع إلى البيت دون طعام أو قطن.
english_before: and returned home without food or fresh cotton.
english_after: and returned home without food or fresh cotton.

arabic: سألته أسرته عما حدث،
english_before: His family wondered
english_after: His family asked him what had happened,

arabic: فأخبرهم أنه ساعد رجلًا محتاجًا.
english_before: how they would eat.
english_after: and he told them he had helped a man in need.

arabic: لم يبق في البيت شيء يمكن بيعه إلا طبق خشبي متشقق وجرة قديمة،
english_before: Only a cracked wooden platter and an old jar remained to sell,
english_after: Nothing was left in the house to sell but a cracked wooden platter and an old jar,

arabic: فأخذهما إلى السوق، لكن أحدًا لم يرغب فيهما.
english_before: but nobody in the market would buy them.
english_after: so he took them to the market, but no one wanted them.

arabic: رأى بائع سمك يعرض سمكة منتفخة ذات رائحة كريهة،
english_before: A fish seller had a swollen, foul-smelling fish
english_after: He saw a fish seller offering a swollen, foul-smelling fish

arabic: ولم يجد من يشتريها.
english_before: that no one wanted.
english_after: that he could not sell to anyone.

arabic: اتفق الرجلان على تبديل السلع،
english_before: They exchanged their unwanted goods,
english_after: The two men agreed to swap their goods,

arabic: فأخذ الرجل السمكة، وترك للبائع الطبق والجرة، ثم عاد إلى أسرته.
english_before: and the man carried the fish home.
english_after: so the man took the fish, left the platter and jar with the seller, and went back to his family.

arabic: فتحت الأسرة بطن السمكة لتعدها للطعام،
english_before: When the family opened the fish,
english_after: The family cut open the fish to prepare it for a meal

arabic: فوجدت لؤلؤة كبيرة داخلها.
english_before: they discovered a large pearl.
english_after: and found a large pearl inside it.

arabic: فحصها الرجل، ورأى أنها لم تثقب من قبل.
english_before: It had never been drilled.
english_after: The man examined it and saw that it had never been drilled.

arabic: وفي اليوم التالي حملها إلى خبير بالأحجار الكريمة ليسأله عن قيمتها.
english_before: The next day the man took it to a jewel expert.
english_after: The next day he took it to a gem expert to ask its value.

arabic: قال الخبير إن اللؤلؤة ثمينة،
english_before: The expert
english_after: The expert said the pearl was valuable,

arabic: لكنه نصحه بزيارة تاجر يملك مالًا أكثر.
english_before: recommended a wealthier buyer.
english_after: but advised him to visit a merchant with more money.

arabic: ذهب الرجل إليه، فدفع له سبعين ألف درهم مقابل اللؤلؤة،
english_before: That merchant paid seventy thousand dirhams for the pearl,
english_after: The man went to him, and the merchant paid seventy thousand dirhams for the pearl,

arabic: وعاد إلى بيته يحمل ثروة لم يتوقعها.
english_before: giving the family a fortune they had never imagined.
english_after: and he returned home carrying a fortune he had never expected.

arabic: عند باب البيت قابله فقير وطلب منه صدقة.
english_before: At his door a beggar asked for help.
english_after: At the door of his house a poor man asked him for charity.

arabic: تذكر الرجل كيف كان محتاجًا بالأمس،
english_before: Remembering his own poverty,
english_after: The man remembered how needy he had been the day before,

arabic: فقسم المال نصفين، وقدم نصفه للفقير دون تردد، مع أن أسرته عانت الجوع منذ وقت قريب.
english_before: the man immediately divided the money in half and offered the beggar one share.
english_after: so he split the money in two and gave half to the poor man without hesitation, though his family had only just gone hungry.

arabic: لكن الفقير أعاد المال إليه،
english_before: The beggar returned the money
english_after: But the poor man gave the money back

arabic: وقال إنه رسول أرسل لاختبار كرمه، وإنه نجح في الامتحان.
english_before: and revealed he was a messenger sent to test the man’s generosity.
english_after: and said he was a messenger sent to test his generosity, and that he had passed the test.

arabic: شكر الرجل الله، وعاش مع أسرته في راحة،
english_before: The family lived comfortably,
english_after: The man thanked God and lived in comfort with his family,

arabic: بعدما ظل مستعدًا للعطاء حتى بعد غناه.
english_before: and the man’s willingness to share had endured.
english_after: having stayed ready to give even after becoming rich.

arabic: كان أبو الحسن الزيادي عالمًا يعيش في بغداد،
english_before: Abu Hassan al-Ziyadi, a scholar in Baghdad,
english_after: Abu Hassan al-Ziyadi, a scholar in Baghdad,

arabic: لكنه وقع في ضيق شديد، حتى صار أصحاب الدكاكين يطالبونه بما عليه من ديون.
english_before: had fallen into debt.
english_after: but he fell into great hardship, until shopkeepers were demanding the debts he owed them.

arabic: وفي يوم زاره رجل من خراسان
english_before: One day a traveler from Khorasan came to him
english_after: One day a man from Khorasan visited him,

arabic: يستعد للسفر لأداء الحج.
english_before: before setting out on pilgrimage.
english_after: who was getting ready to travel for the Hajj pilgrimage.

arabic: قال الخراساني إنه يحمل عشرة آلاف درهم،
english_before: The traveler asked Abu Hassan
english_after: The man from Khorasan said he was carrying ten thousand dirhams

arabic: ويخشى أن يضيع المال أثناء السفر.
english_before: to safeguard ten thousand dirhams.
english_after: and feared the money would be lost on the journey.

arabic: طلب من أبي الحسن حفظه إلى عودته،
english_before: If he returned, the money remained his;
english_after: He asked Abu Hassan to keep it safe until his return,

arabic: وأضاف أنه إن مات في الطريق أصبح المال هدية لصاحب البيت.
english_before: if he died during the pilgrimage, it would become a gift.
english_after: adding that if he died on the way, the money would become a gift to the master of the house.

arabic: وافق أبو الحسن وتسلم المال،
english_before: Abu Hassan agreed
english_after: Abu Hassan agreed and took the money,

arabic: لكنه استخدمه في سداد ديونه والإنفاق على أهله،
english_before: but used the deposit to pay his debts,
english_after: but used it to pay his debts and provide for his family,

arabic: ظانًا أنه سيجد ما يعوضه قبل عودة الحاج.
english_before: hoping to replace it before the pilgrim returned.
english_after: thinking he would find something to replace it before the pilgrim returned.

arabic: وفي صباح اليوم التالي عاد الخراساني على غير انتظار.
english_before: Unexpectedly, the traveler came back the very next morning.
english_after: The next morning, unexpectedly, the man from Khorasan came back.

arabic: قال الزائر إن أباه قد مات، ولذلك ألغى سفره
english_before: The traveler had learned that his father died and canceled the pilgrimage.
english_after: The visitor said his father had died, so he had canceled his journey

arabic: ويريد ماله فورًا.
english_before: He demanded his money.
english_after: and wanted his money at once.

arabic: ارتبك أبو الحسن، وطلب إليه أن يعود غدًا،
english_before: Abu Hassan asked him to return tomorrow,
english_after: Flustered, Abu Hassan asked him to come back tomorrow,

arabic: مدعيًا أن الكيس عند شخص آخر. ثم قضى الليل قلقًا لا ينام.
english_before: claiming another person held the deposit.
english_after: claiming the purse was with someone else. Then he spent a sleepless, anxious night.

arabic: خرج أبو الحسن عند الفجر يركب بغلته دون أن يعرف أين يذهب.
english_before: At dawn Abu Hassan rode aimlessly
english_after: At dawn Abu Hassan rode out on his mule without knowing where to go.

arabic: قابله رجال يبحثون عنه بأمر الخليفة المأمون،
english_before: until men sent by Caliph al-Maamun found him.
english_after: He met men searching for him on the orders of Caliph al-Maamun,

arabic: فاصطحبوه إلى القصر.
english_before: Taken to court,
english_after: and they took him to the palace.

arabic: سأله الخليفة عن همومه، فقص عليه ما حدث بالتفصيل.
english_before: he told the caliph his whole predicament.
english_after: The caliph asked about his troubles, and he told him everything that had happened in detail.

arabic: تقول الحكاية إن المأمون رأى في نومه رؤيا تكررت،
english_before: The tale says the caliph had repeatedly dreamed
english_after: The tale says al-Maamun had a recurring dream

arabic: تأمره بمساعدة أبي الحسن. لهذا أرسل يبحث عنه.
english_before: that he must help Abu Hassan.
english_after: telling him to help Abu Hassan. That was why he had sent for him.
note: omitted why he sent for him

arabic: أعطاه عشرة آلاف درهم ليرد الأمانة،
english_before: He gave him ten thousand dirhams for repayment,
english_after: He gave him ten thousand dirhams to repay the deposit,

arabic: وعشرة آلاف أخرى لحاجاته، وثلاثين ألفًا ليصلح بها أمره.
english_before: ten thousand more for expenses and thirty thousand to rebuild his life.
english_after: ten thousand more for his needs, and thirty thousand to set his affairs right.

arabic: عاد أبو الحسن، وجاء الخراساني يطلب ماله.
english_before: The traveler arrived,
english_after: Abu Hassan went back, and the man from Khorasan came asking for his money.

arabic: عرض عليه المبلغ كاملًا، وروى له قصة الخليفة.
english_before: and Abu Hassan offered the full repayment and explained what had happened.
english_after: He offered him the full sum and told him the caliph's story.

arabic: بكى الرجل وقال إنه لو عرف ضيق أبي الحسن لما طالبه بالمال،
english_before: Moved to tears,
english_after: The man wept and said that had he known Abu Hassan's hardship, he would not have asked for the money,

arabic: ثم عفا عنه ورفض أخذ الدراهم.
english_before: the man forgave the debt and refused the money.
english_after: then he forgave him and refused to take the dirhams.

arabic: وفي يوم رسمي عاد أبو الحسن إلى القصر كما أمره المأمون.
english_before: On an appointed day Abu Hassan returned to court,
english_after: On an official day Abu Hassan returned to the palace, as al-Maamun had ordered.

arabic: فاجأه الخليفة بتعيينه قاضيًا في قسم من المدينة المنورة،
english_before: where al-Maamun named him a judge over part of Medina
english_after: The caliph surprised him by appointing him judge over part of Medina,

arabic: مع راتب معلوم.
english_before: with an allowance.
english_after: with a fixed salary.

arabic: بقي في منصبه سنوات، واشتهرت قصته بين الناس.
english_before: He remained in office for years.
english_after: He stayed in office for years, and his story became famous among the people.

arabic: كان رجل غني قد خسر ماله كله،
english_before: A once-rich man lost his fortune
english_after: A once-rich man lost his fortune

arabic: وأصبح عاجزًا عن تدبير شؤون بيته.
english_before: and could no longer support his household.
english_after: and could no longer support his household.

arabic: نصحته زوجته أن يستعين بصديق قديم يعرفه ويثق به،
english_before: His wife urged him to ask
english_after: His wife advised him to seek help from an old friend he knew and trusted,

arabic: فذهب إليه وأخبره بما أصابه من فقر وضيق.
english_before: an old trusted friend for help.
english_after: so he went to him and told him of the poverty and hardship he had suffered.

arabic: استمع الصديق إليه، وأعطاه خمسمئة دينار ليبدأ عملًا جديدًا.
english_before: The friend gave him five hundred dinars.
english_after: The friend listened and gave him five hundred dinars to start new work.

arabic: وكان الرجل قد عمل صائغًا في شبابه،
english_before: Having worked as a jeweler in his youth,
english_after: Having worked as a jeweler in his youth,

arabic: فاستأجر دكانًا في سوق الجواهر،
english_before: the man rented a shop in the jewel market
english_after: so he rented a shop in the jewel market,

arabic: واشترى بعض البضاعة، وجلس ينتظر الزبائن.
english_before: and began trading again.
english_after: bought some goods and sat waiting for customers.

arabic: جاء إلى الدكان ثلاثة رجال، وسألوه عن أبيه.
english_before: Three men came asking about his father.
english_after: Three men came to the shop and asked him about his father.

arabic: أخبرهم أن والده قد مات، فسألوه إن كان ابنه فعلًا.
english_before: Told the father had died,
english_after: He told them his father had died, and they asked whether he was really his son.

arabic: جمع بعض أهل السوق، فشهدوا أمامهم أن الرجل ابن ذلك التاجر المتوفى.
english_before: they asked witnesses from the market to confirm the jeweler was truly his son.
english_after: He gathered some market people, who testified before them that he was that late merchant's son.

arabic: عندئذ سلموه حقيبتين
english_before: They handed him two bags
english_after: They handed him two bags

arabic: فيهما ثلاثون ألف دينار، وحلي وأحجار نفيسة.
english_before: holding thirty thousand dinars and precious jewels,
english_after: holding thirty thousand dinars, ornaments and precious stones.

arabic: قالوا إن أباه ترك هذه الأشياء عندهم أمانة قبل وفاته،
english_before: saying his late father had entrusted the goods to them
english_after: They said his father had left these with them in trust before he died,

arabic: وإنهم جاءوا ليعيدوها إلى وريثه الشرعي.
english_before: for his heir.
english_after: and that they had come to return them to his rightful heir.

arabic: وبعد قليل حضرت امرأة إلى الدكان،
english_before: Soon a woman arrived
english_after: Soon after, a woman came to the shop

arabic: واختارت جواهر كان ثمنها خمسمئة دينار، لكنها دفعت ثلاثة آلاف دينار.
english_before: and bought jewels worth five hundred dinars for three thousand.
english_after: and chose jewels priced at five hundred dinars, but paid three thousand dinars.

arabic: تعجب الرجل من هذه الأحداث،
english_before: The astonished jeweler
english_after: The man was amazed at these events

arabic: وشعر أن أبواب الرزق قد فتحت له فجأة.
english_before: believed fortune had unexpectedly returned.
english_after: and felt the doors of fortune had suddenly opened to him.

arabic: حمل خمسمئة دينار إلى صديقه، وقال إنه يريد رد المال الذي اقترضه.
english_before: He brought five hundred dinars to repay his friend.
english_after: He took five hundred dinars to his friend and said he wanted to repay what he had borrowed.

arabic: لكن الصديق رفض، وأخبره أنه قدمه هدية منذ البداية،
english_before: The friend refused, saying it had been a gift,
english_after: But the friend refused, telling him it had been a gift from the start,

arabic: ثم أعطاه ورقة وطلب منه ألا يفتحها إلا في بيته.
english_before: and handed him a sealed note to read at home.
english_after: then gave him a paper and asked him not to open it until he was home.

arabic: فتح الرجل الورقة، فوجد فيها أبياتًا تكشف الحقيقة.
english_before: At home he read verses revealing the truth.
english_after: The man opened the paper and found in it verses revealing the truth.

arabic: الثلاثة الذين جاءوا إلى السوق كانوا أقارب صديقه،
english_before: The three men were his friend’s relatives,
english_after: The three men who had come to the market were his friend's relatives,

arabic: والمرأة التي اشترت الجواهر كانت أم الصديق،
english_before: the buyer was his friend’s mother,
english_after: and the woman who bought the jewels was his friend's mother,

arabic: أما الأموال والحلي فقد أرسلها الصديق سرًا.
english_before: and all the money and jewels came from his friend.
english_after: while the money and ornaments had been sent secretly by his friend.

arabic: كتب الصديق أنه دبّر ذلك كله
english_before: The note explained that the friend had arranged everything
english_after: The friend wrote that he had arranged it all

arabic: حتى يساعده من غير أن يحرجه بطلب المال أمامه.
english_before: to help without embarrassing him.
english_after: to help him without the embarrassment of asking for money face to face.

arabic: فهم الرجل عندها أن ثروته الجديدة لم تكن ميراثًا مجهولًا،
english_before: The new fortune was not a forgotten inheritance,
english_after: The man then understood that his new wealth was no unknown inheritance,

arabic: بل ثمرة وفاء صديق حفظ كرامته.
english_before: but an act of loyalty that preserved his dignity.
english_after: but the fruit of a loyal friend who had protected his dignity.

arabic: هرب الشاعر المتلمس من الملك النعمان بن المنذر،
english_before: The poet al-Mutalammis fled King al-Numan
english_after: The poet al-Mutalammis fled from King al-Numan ibn al-Mundhir

arabic: وغاب عن أهله زمنًا طويلًا.
english_before: and remained away for a long time.
english_after: and was away from his family for a long time.

arabic: انتظرته زوجته أميمة بقلق، ولم يصلها منه خبر يطمئنها،
english_before: His wife Umaymah waited anxiously
english_after: His wife Umaymah waited anxiously, with no news of him to reassure her,

arabic: حتى شاع بين الناس أنه مات ولن يعود.
english_before: until people began to believe he was dead.
english_after: until word spread among the people that he had died and would not return.

arabic: كانت أميمة تحب زوجها حبًا كبيرًا،
english_before: Umaymah loved him deeply
english_after: Umaymah loved him deeply

arabic: ولذلك رفضت أن تتزوج غيره.
english_before: and refused to remarry.
english_after: and refused to remarry.

arabic: لكن أهلها قالوا إن عليها أن تبدأ حياة جديدة،
english_before: Her relatives urged her to begin anew,
english_after: But her family said she must begin a new life,

arabic: وإن الانتظار لا فائدة منه بعدما انقطعت أخبار الرجل كل تلك السنوات.
english_before: arguing that years without news made further waiting hopeless.
english_after: and that waiting was useless after all those years without news of him.

arabic: كثر الذين طلبوا يدها،
english_before: Many suitors came.
english_after: Many men asked for her hand,

arabic: واستمر ضغط أهلها عليها حتى وافقت أخيرًا، وهي غير مطمئنة إلى قرارها.
english_before: Finally she agreed reluctantly,
english_after: and her family kept pressing her until she finally agreed, though uneasy about her decision.

arabic: حددوا ليلة للزفاف، واجتمع الناس في الحي،
english_before: and the family arranged a wedding.
english_after: They set a night for the wedding, and people gathered in the camp,

arabic: وسمعت أصوات الغناء والدفوف من الخيام.
english_before: Songs and drums sounded through the camp on the appointed night.
english_after: and the sound of singing and drums came from the tents.

arabic: وفي تلك الليلة نفسها عاد المتلمس من سفره،
english_before: On that very night al-Mutalammis returned
english_after: That very night al-Mutalammis returned from his journey

arabic: ورأى الزينة وسمع الفرح.
english_before: and saw the celebration.
english_after: and saw the decorations and heard the celebration.

arabic: سأل صبيانًا عن سبب الاحتفال،
english_before: Children told him that Umaymah,
english_after: He asked some boys the reason for the celebration,

arabic: فأخبروه أن أميمة، زوجة المتلمس الذي يظنونه ميتًا، تتزوج رجلًا آخر.
english_before: the wife of the man everyone thought dead, was marrying someone else.
english_after: and they told him that Umaymah, wife of al-Mutalammis, whom they thought dead, was marrying another man.

arabic: دهش الشاعر وتألم، ثم دخل بين الحاضرين دون أن يعرفه أحد.
english_before: Shocked and hurt, the poet entered unnoticed among the guests.
english_after: The poet was shocked and hurt, then slipped in among the guests without anyone recognizing him.

arabic: رأى أميمة قرب العريس الجديد، وكانت حزينة رغم الاحتفال.
english_before: He saw Umaymah grieving beside her new groom,
english_after: He saw Umaymah near the new groom, sad despite the celebration.

arabic: وعندما اقترب العريس منها، تنهدت وأخذت تردد بيتًا من الشعر.
english_before: and she began to recite a sorrowful verse.
english_after: When the groom came near her, she sighed and began repeating a line of verse.
note: omitted groom approaching and her sigh

arabic: تساءلت أميمة في بيتها أين أصبح زوجها الغائب،
english_before: Umaymah wondered aloud in verse
english_after: In her verse Umaymah wondered where her absent husband had gone,

arabic: وفي أي أرض بعيدة يعيش إن كان حيًا.
english_before: where her absent husband might be.
english_after: and in what far land he lived, if he was still alive.
note: omitted 'in what far land, if alive'

arabic: لم يستطع المتلمس أن يصمت، فأجابها ببيت من شعره
english_before: Al-Mutalammis answered with his own verse:
english_after: Al-Mutalammis could not stay silent, and answered her with a verse of his own

arabic: يقول إنه قريب، وإنه لم ينس حبها.
english_before: he was close at hand and had never forgotten her.
english_after: saying that he was near and had not forgotten his love for her.

arabic: عرفت أميمة صوت زوجها،
english_before: Umaymah recognized her husband’s voice.
english_after: Umaymah recognized her husband's voice,

arabic: وفهم العريس الجديد حقيقة ما حدث.
english_before: The new groom understood at once
english_after: and the new groom understood what had really happened.

arabic: لم يغضب الرجل ولم يخاصمهما، بل أنشد كلمات تدل على أنه سيتنحى،
english_before: and, without quarreling, spoke graciously
english_after: The man did not grow angry or quarrel with them, but recited words showing he would step aside,
note: omitted that he would step aside

arabic: ثم ترك لهما المكان وانصرف دون أن يعود.
english_before: and withdrew, leaving the reunited couple alone.
english_after: then left the place to them and went away, never to return.

arabic: عاد المتلمس إلى أميمة بعد غياب ظنه الناس نهاية حياته.
english_before: After an absence everyone mistook for death,
english_after: Al-Mutalammis returned to Umaymah after an absence people had thought was the end of his life.

arabic: وبقي الزوجان معًا في راحة وسرور بعد أن زال سوء الفهم،
english_before: al-Mutalammis and Umaymah were together again.
english_after: The couple stayed together in peace and happiness once the misunderstanding was cleared,

arabic: وصارت ليلة الزفاف التي بدت حزينة يومًا لعودتهما إلى بعضهما.
english_before: The wedding night became the night of their reunion.
english_after: and the wedding night that had seemed sad became a day of their return to each other.

arabic: خرج الخليفة الحاكم بأمر الله يومًا في موكب كبير،
english_before: Caliph al-Hakim rode in a great procession
english_after: One day Caliph al-Hakim bi-Amr Allah rode out in a great procession

arabic: ومر ببستان جميل تحيط به الأشجار.
english_before: past a beautiful garden.
english_after: and passed a beautiful garden surrounded by trees.

arabic: رأى رجلًا جالسًا فيه مع خدمه،
english_before: He saw a man among his servants
english_after: He saw a man sitting there with his servants

arabic: فطلب منه شربة ماء، فأسرع الرجل وقدّم له ما يشرب.
english_before: and asked for water, which the man readily provided.
english_after: and asked him for a drink of water, and the man hurried to bring him something to drink.

arabic: دعا صاحب البستان الخليفة إلى النزول والاستراحة،
english_before: The garden’s owner invited the caliph to rest.
english_after: The garden's owner invited the caliph to dismount and rest,

arabic: فوافق ودخل مع من رافقه.
english_before: He accepted,
english_after: and he agreed and went in with those who came with him.

arabic: وفجأة ظهر الخدم يحملون سجادًا ووسائد كثيرة،
english_before: and attendants quickly spread many rugs and cushions
english_after: Suddenly servants appeared carrying many rugs and cushions,

arabic: ويجهزون للضيوف أماكن واسعة للجلوس تحت الأشجار.
english_before: beneath the trees for his entourage.
english_after: and prepared wide places for the guests to sit beneath the trees.

arabic: ثم جاءت أطباق الفاكهة والحلوى، وأوعية الشراب البارد، وألوان كثيرة من الطعام.
english_before: Platters of fruit and sweets, cool drinks and food
english_after: Then came platters of fruit and sweets, vessels of cool drinks and many kinds of food.

arabic: بلغ عدد بعض هذه الأشياء مئة من كل نوع،
english_before: followed—some items numbering a hundred each.
english_after: Some of these things numbered a hundred of each kind,

arabic: حتى تعجب الخليفة من سرعة تجهيز مائدة بهذا الحجم.
english_before: The caliph wondered how such an enormous feast had appeared so quickly.
english_after: so that the caliph marveled at how quickly a table this large had been prepared.

arabic: سأل الحاكم صاحب البستان إن كان يعلم مسبقًا بمرور الموكب،
english_before: Al-Hakim asked whether the merchant had expected his visit
english_after: Al-Hakim asked the garden's owner whether he had known in advance the procession would pass

arabic: وأعد كل ذلك انتظارًا له.
english_before: and prepared in advance.
english_after: and had prepared all this awaiting him.

arabic: أجاب الرجل أنه لم يسمع بخبر الزيارة،
english_before: The host insisted
english_after: The man replied that he had heard nothing of the visit,

arabic: وأن ما يراه الخليفة جزء من نظام بيته اليومي المعتاد.
english_before: that he had known nothing of it.
english_after: and that what the caliph saw was part of his household's usual daily routine.

arabic: وأوضح التاجر أن في بيته مئة جارية،
english_before: The merchant explained that a hundred women in his household
english_after: The merchant explained that there were a hundred maidservants in his house,

arabic: وأن كل واحدة ترسل كل يوم طعامًا وشرابًا وأشياء للاستراحة.
english_before: each sent daily food, drink and furnishings.
english_after: and each one sent food, drink and things for resting every day.

arabic: وعندما نزل الخليفة جمع الخدم ما يأتي عادة من الجميع،
english_before: His servants had simply gathered the usual contributions
english_after: When the caliph stopped, the servants gathered what usually came from all of them

arabic: وقدموه للزائرين.
english_before: for the visitors.
english_after: and served it to the visitors.

arabic: لم يكن القصد إقامة وليمة خاصة،
english_before: It was no specially arranged banquet:
english_after: It was not meant as a special banquet,

arabic: بل إن المائدة التي رآها الخليفة
english_before: the lavish spread
english_after: but the spread the caliph saw

arabic: كانت مما يصل إلى صاحب البستان في يوم عادي.
english_before: was part of an ordinary day.
english_after: was what reached the garden's owner on an ordinary day.

arabic: ازداد الحاكم دهشة عندما فهم مقدار المال الذي يستطيع هذا التاجر أن ينفقه.
english_before: The caliph was even more astonished by the merchant’s wealth and hospitality.
english_after: Al-Hakim grew even more amazed when he grasped how much money this merchant could spend.

arabic: شكر الخليفة الله على ما رأى من سعة رزق أحد رعيته،
english_before: The caliph thanked God for the prosperity of one of his subjects.
english_after: The caliph thanked God for the abundant provision he saw given to one of his subjects,

arabic: ثم أمر بإحضار ما جمع في خزينة الدولة من دراهم ضُربت في تلك السنة،
english_before: He ordered the treasury to bring the dirhams minted
english_after: then ordered the dirhams minted that year and collected in the state treasury to be brought,

arabic: وكان عددها ثلاثة ملايين وسبعمئة ألف درهم.
english_before: that year—three million seven hundred thousand.
english_after: and they numbered three million seven hundred thousand dirhams.

arabic: أعطى الخليفة المال كله إلى التاجر،
english_before: He gave all the money to the merchant,
english_after: He gave all the money to the merchant,

arabic: وقال إن كرم الضيافة يستحق أكثر من ذلك.
english_before: declaring such hospitality deserved even more,
english_after: and said that such generous hospitality deserved more than that.

arabic: ثم ركب جواده وعاد إلى قصره،
english_before: and rode away.
english_after: Then he mounted his horse and returned to his palace,

arabic: وبقيت زيارة الماء القصيرة سببًا في هدية لم يتوقعها صاحب البستان.
english_before: A simple request for water had brought an extraordinary gift.
english_after: and a short stop for water became the reason for a gift the garden's owner never expected.

arabic: خرج الملك أنوشروان العادل للصيد،
english_before: King Anushirwan became separated from his hunting party
english_after: King Anushirwan the Just went out hunting

arabic: وابتعد عن رجاله وهو يطارد غزالًا.
english_before: while chasing a deer.
english_after: and strayed from his men while chasing a gazelle.

arabic: اشتد عطشه في الطريق، فرأى قرية صغيرة،
english_before: Thirsty, he stopped at a village house
english_after: On the way his thirst grew strong, and he saw a small village,

arabic: ووقف عند بيت قريب يسأل أهله عن ماء يشربه قبل أن يكمل رحلته.
english_before: and asked for a drink.
english_after: and stopped at a nearby house to ask its people for water before going on.

arabic: خرجت فتاة من البيت، ثم عادت وعصرت عودًا واحدًا من قصب السكر في إناء،
english_before: A young woman squeezed one stalk of sugarcane into a bowl,
english_after: A young woman came out of the house, then went back and squeezed a single sugarcane stalk into a bowl,
note: omitted coming out and going back

arabic: ومزجت العصير بالماء.
english_before: diluted it with water,
english_after: and mixed the juice with water.

arabic: وضعت فوقه مسحوقًا عطريًا خفيفًا،
english_before: added a little scented powder
english_after: She sprinkled a little fragrant powder on top

arabic: وقدمت الشراب للضيف الذي لم تعرف أنه الملك.
english_before: and served the stranger.
english_after: and served the drink to the guest, not knowing he was the king.
note: omitted 'not knowing he was the king'

arabic: شرب أنوشروان على مهل، وأعجبه الطعم،
english_before: He enjoyed the drink
english_after: Anushirwan drank slowly and liked the taste,

arabic: لكنه سأل الفتاة عن سبب وضع المسحوق الذي جعله لا يشرب بسرعة.
english_before: but asked about the powder.
english_after: but asked the young woman why she had added the powder that kept him from drinking quickly.

arabic: أجابته أنها رأته شديد العطش،
english_before: She said his thirst was so great
english_after: She answered that she had seen how very thirsty he was

arabic: وخافت أن يبتلع الماء كله دفعة واحدة فيؤذيه.
english_before: she wanted him to sip slowly instead of swallowing it all at once.
english_after: and feared he would swallow all the water at once and hurt himself.

arabic: سر الملك بحكمتها، وسألها عن عدد أعواد القصب التي استعملتها.
english_before: Impressed by her thoughtfulness, he asked how many stalks she had used.
english_after: The king was pleased by her wisdom and asked how many sugarcane stalks she had used.

arabic: قالت إنها استخدمت عودًا واحدًا فقط.
english_before: Only one, she replied.
english_after: She said she had used only one stalk.

arabic: تعجب من وفرة العصير،
english_before: Seeing the village’s low taxes,
english_after: He marveled at how much juice there was,

arabic: ثم نظر في مقدار الضرائب المفروضة على القرية، ووجدها قليلة.
english_before: he considered raising them.
english_after: then looked at the taxes levied on the village and found them low.

arabic: فكر الملك في زيادة الضرائب عند عودته إلى قصره،
english_before: The king decided he might raise the taxes
english_after: The king thought of raising the taxes when he got back to his palace,

arabic: لأن الأرض تبدو شديدة الخصوبة.
english_before: on such fertile land.
english_after: since the land seemed very fertile.

arabic: مضى في صيده، ثم رجع من الطريق نفسه مساءً،
english_before: Later that day he returned along the same road
english_after: He went on with his hunt, then came back the same way in the evening

arabic: وتوقف عند بيت الفتاة ليطلب شرابًا آخر.
english_before: and asked the young woman for another drink.
english_after: and stopped at the young woman's house to ask for another drink.

arabic: تأخرت الفتاة هذه المرة، فسألها عن السبب.
english_before: This time she took much longer.
english_after: This time the young woman was slow, and he asked her why.

arabic: قالت إن عودًا واحدًا لم يعطها عصيرًا يكفي، فاستعملت ثلاثة أعواد،
english_before: She explained that even three stalks
english_after: She said one stalk had not given enough juice, so she had used three,

arabic: ومع ذلك لم تحصل على مقدار العصير الذي خرج من العود الأول صباحًا.
english_before: had yielded less juice than the single stalk that morning.
english_after: and even so she had not got as much juice as the first stalk gave that morning.

arabic: سألها الملك عن تفسير ذلك،
english_before: Asked why,
english_after: The king asked her to explain this,

arabic: فقالت إن الخير يقل عندما ينوي الحاكم ظلم الناس،
english_before: she said prosperity weakens
english_after: and she said that blessings dwindle when a ruler means to wrong the people,

arabic: وإن الأرض تتأثر بسوء حكمه.
english_before: when a ruler turns against his people.
english_after: and the land suffers from his bad rule.

arabic: فهم الملك كلامها، وتذكر أنه كان قد عزم على زيادة الضرائب على أهل القرية.
english_before: The king remembered his own intention to increase their taxes.
english_after: The king understood her words and remembered he had resolved to raise the village's taxes.

arabic: ترك أنوشروان فكرة زيادة الضرائب،
english_before: Anushirwan abandoned the tax increase
english_after: Anushirwan gave up the idea of raising the taxes,

arabic: وأعجب بذكاء الفتاة وجرأتها، فتزوجها كما تروي الحكاية.
english_before: and, the tale says, married the clever young woman.
english_after: and, admiring the young woman's intelligence and courage, he married her, as the tale tells.

arabic: وهكذا غيّرت كلمات فتاة من قرية صغيرة قرار ملك كان يستطيع أن يزيد العبء على أهلها.
english_before: Her words had changed a powerful ruler’s decision.
english_after: And so the words of a young woman from a small village changed the decision of a king who could have added to her people's burden.

arabic: عاد يحيى بن خالد البرمكي ذات يوم
english_before: Yahya ibn Khalid al-Barmaki returned home
english_after: One day Yahya ibn Khalid al-Barmaki returned

arabic: من قصر الخليفة إلى بيته في بغداد.
english_before: from the caliph’s palace
english_after: from the caliph's palace to his house in Baghdad.

arabic: وعند باب الدار رأى رجلًا فقيرًا ينتظره.
english_before: and found a poor man waiting at his gate,
english_after: At the door of his house he saw a poor man waiting for him,

arabic: وقف الرجل احترامًا له، وسلم عليه، ثم قال إنه جاء يطلب مساعدته.
english_before: hoping for help.
english_after: The man stood out of respect, greeted him, then said he had come to ask for his help.

arabic: أخبر الرجل يحيى أنه في حاجة شديدة إلى المال،
english_before: The man explained
english_after: The man told Yahya that he badly needed money,

arabic: وطلب منه أن يكون كريمًا معه.
english_before: his desperate need.
english_after: and asked him to be generous with him.

arabic: لم يسأله يحيى عن نسبه أو عمله،
english_before: Yahya asked neither about his family nor his occupation,
english_after: Yahya asked neither about his family nor his occupation,

arabic: بل أمر أن يجهزوا له غرفة مريحة داخل البيت.
english_before: but ordered a comfortable room prepared for him inside.
english_after: but ordered a comfortable room prepared for him inside.

arabic: ثم استدعى يحيى خازنه،
english_before: Yahya instructed his treasurer
english_after: Then Yahya summoned his treasurer

arabic: وأمره أن يعطي الضيف ألف درهم كل يوم،
english_before: to give the guest one thousand dirhams daily
english_after: and ordered him to give the guest a thousand dirhams every day,

arabic: وأن يقدم له من الطعام الجيد مثل ما يأكل أهل البيت.
english_before: and serve him the same fine food enjoyed by the household,
english_after: and serve him the same fine food enjoyed by the household,

arabic: لم يحدد له يومًا تنتهي فيه الضيافة.
english_before: without setting a deadline.
english_after: without setting a deadline.

arabic: بقي الرجل في الدار أيامًا، ثم أسابيع،
english_before: The man stayed for days and then weeks,
english_after: The man stayed for days and then weeks,

arabic: وهو يأكل ويستريح ويتلقى المال بانتظام.
english_before: eating well and receiving the regular payment.
english_after: eating, resting and receiving the money regularly.

arabic: وكل صباح كانت تصل إليه ألف درهم جديدة،
english_before: Each morning brought
english_after: Every morning a new thousand dirhams reached him,

arabic: حتى جمع مبلغًا لم يحلم يومًا أن يكون في يده.
english_before: another thousand dirhams.
english_after: until he had gathered a sum he had never dreamed of holding.

arabic: مرت ثلاثون ليلة، فصار معه ثلاثون ألف درهم.
english_before: After thirty days he held thirty thousand dirhams.
english_after: After thirty days he held thirty thousand dirhams.

arabic: أخذ يتأمل الكيس الكبير،
english_before: He began to fear
english_after: He gazed at the big bag,

arabic: وخاف أن يراجع يحيى حسابه، فيرى أن المبلغ تجاوز ما ينبغي،
english_before: that Yahya would notice how much he had received
english_after: and feared Yahya would check his account, see the sum had gone beyond what was proper,
note: omitted checking the account, exceeding the proper sum

arabic: ثم يطلب منه إعادة جزء منه.
english_before: and demand some back.
english_after: and demand some back.

arabic: لم يشأ الرجل أن ينتظر حتى يتبين الأمر،
english_before: Rather than risk the imagined demand,
english_after: The man did not want to wait until the matter became clear,

arabic: فجمع أمتعته في هدوء، وحمل المال كله،
english_before: he packed quietly
english_after: so he quietly gathered his belongings and carried off all the money,

arabic: وخرج من البيت سرًا دون وداع.
english_before: and slipped away with all the money,
english_after: and left the house secretly without saying goodbye.

arabic: وظن أنه بهذه الطريقة سيحتفظ بما حصل عليه من العطاء.
english_before: saying no farewell.
english_after: He thought that this way he would keep the gifts he had received.

arabic: عندما علم الخدم برحيله،
english_before: When servants reported
english_after: When the servants learned of his departure,

arabic: أخبروا يحيى أنه غادر خفية بعدما جمع ثلاثين ألف درهم.
english_before: his secret departure,
english_after: they told Yahya he had slipped away after collecting thirty thousand dirhams.

arabic: لم يغضب يحيى، ولم يرسل أحدًا ليعيده،
english_before: Yahya neither grew angry nor sent anyone after him.
english_after: Yahya did not grow angry, nor did he send anyone to bring him back,

arabic: بل تعجب من أن الرجل ظن الكرم يمكن أن ينتهي فجأة.
english_before: He was surprised that the man had feared his generosity would end.
english_after: but marveled that the man had thought generosity could suddenly end.

arabic: قال يحيى إنه لو بقي الضيف في بيته حتى آخر عمره،
english_before: Yahya declared that even if the guest had stayed for life,
english_after: Yahya said that if the guest had stayed in his house to the end of his life,

arabic: لما قطع عنه الطعام ولا المال.
english_before: he would never have stopped the gifts or meals.
english_after: he would never have stopped the gifts or meals.

arabic: وهكذا انتهت القصة برحيل الرجل مع ما جمعه،
english_before: The man was gone,
english_after: So the story ended with the man leaving with what he had gathered,

arabic: وبقاء باب الضيافة مفتوحًا في نية صاحبه.
english_before: though the welcome had never ended.
english_after: while the door of hospitality stayed open in its owner's heart.

arabic: كان سعيد بن سالم يعيش في زمن الخليفة هارون الرشيد،
english_before: Said ibn Salim lived in Harun al-Rashid’s time
english_after: Said ibn Salim lived in the time of Caliph Harun al-Rashid,

arabic: وقد تراكمت عليه ديون كثيرة.
english_before: and had fallen deep into debt.
english_after: and had fallen deep into debt.

arabic: صار الدائنون يأتون إلى بابه كل يوم، ويطالبونه بأموالهم،
english_before: Creditors crowded his door daily,
english_after: Creditors came to his door every day, demanding their money,

arabic: حتى ضاقت به السبل ولم يعرف من أين يبدأ.
english_before: leaving him desperate.

arabic: ذهب إلى رجل يعرفه اسمه عبد الله بن مالك،

english_after: He went to a man he knew named Abdullah ibn Malik

arabic: تردد سعيد،

arabic: خرج سعيد حزينًا، وعاد إلى عبد الله يشكو أن الزيارة لم تنفعه.

arabic: دعاه عبد الله إلى الجلوس بقية اليوم، لعل شيئًا يتغير.

arabic: جلس الرجل مهمومًا،
english_before: and Said sat
english_after: The man sat, troubled,

english_before: worrying about his debts.

english_after: three million three hundred thousand dirhams.

arabic: عندها فهم أن الفضل وجعفر لم يكتفيا بالكلام الطيب،

arabic: تحكي رواية قديمة أن الخليفة المأمون وصل إلى مصر،

arabic: سمع أن الناس يتحدثون عن كنوز مخبأة داخلها،

arabic: تعجب الخليفة من هذا الاتفاق الغريب، وأدرك أنه لم يربح شيئًا من محاولته المكلفة.

arabic: أخذ ما وجده،
english_before: the caliph took what had been discovered
